STR-EFFETS-COMBINES.definition: In the same case: qualitative information on these financial effects, with the line items, totals and subtotals of the financial statements affected or likely to be, and quantitative information on the combined effects of this risk or opportunity with others, unless it would not be useful (ESRS 2 §31(b), (c)). Answer N/A otherwise.

STR-RESILIENCE.name: Resilience of the strategy and business model
STR-RESILIENCE.definition: Qualitative information on the capacity of the strategy and business model to manage the material risks, with how the analysis was conducted and the time horizons considered (ESRS 2 §33).

GEN-MAT-PROCESSUS.name: Process to identify and assess impacts, risks and opportunities
GEN-MAT-PROCESSUS.definition: Concise description of the process and decision-making steps followed to identify the impacts, risks and opportunities and the related topics, and to assess their materiality: coverage of the own operations and the value chain, key methods, inputs and assumptions, qualitative criteria or quantitative thresholds, dependencies (ESRS 2 §35(a), AR 22 to 24). The tool does not run the assessment: it collects its description. Source: File of the double materiality assessment (method, results, approval).

GEN-MAT-PRIORISATION.name: How impacts are assessed and prioritised
GEN-MAT-PRIORISATION.definition: How the impacts were assessed and prioritised by severity and likelihood, how actions to prevent, mitigate, bring to an end, minimise and remediate negative impacts are considered, and how areas of heightened risk related to activities, business relationships or geographies were considered (ESRS 2 §35(b), AR 24 to 26). Source: File of the double materiality assessment (method, results, approval).

GEN-MAT-DILIGENCE.name: Assessment informed by due diligence
GEN-MAT-DILIGENCE.definition: Is the assessment of the material impacts, risks and opportunities informed by the company's sustainability due diligence process (ESRS 2 §35(c))?

GEN-MAT-CONSULTATIONS.name: Consultation of stakeholders and experts in the assessment
GEN-MAT-CONSULTATIONS.definition: If the company consults affected stakeholders and external experts to understand its impacts: how these consultations inform the assessment (ESRS 2 §35(c), AR 25). Answer N/A otherwise.

GEN-MAT-CHANGEMENTS.name: Significant changes to the assessment process
GEN-MAT-CHANGEMENTS.definition: Significant changes to the process compared with the previous period (ESRS 2 §35(d)). Answer N/A if there is none.

GEN-MAT-DATE.name: Date of the last update of the materiality assessment
GEN-MAT-DATE.definition: Date on which the materiality assessment was last updated, as YYYY-MM-DD (ESRS 2 §35(e)).

GEN-IRO-DESCRIPTION.name: Description of the material impacts, risks and opportunities
GEN-IRO-DESCRIPTION.definition: Concise description of the actual and potential, positive and negative material impacts and of how they affect or are likely to affect people or the environment, then of the material risks and opportunities with their dependencies; say where they are in the own operations and the value chain (ESRS 2 §37(a), AR 27, AR 28). The next table lists them one by one. Source: File of the double materiality assessment (method, results, approval).

GEN-IRO-TAB.name: List of material impacts, risks and opportunities
GEN-IRO-TAB.unit: table: Impact, risk or opportunity, Type, Topic, Place in the value chain, Time horizon
GEN-IRO-TAB.definition: One row per material impact, risk or opportunity: short title, type (actual or potential, positive or negative impact, risk, opportunity), related ESRS topic, place in the value chain, time horizon (ESRS 2 §37(a)). Source: File of the double materiality assessment (method, results, approval).

GEN-CLIMAT-NON-MATERIEL.name: Why climate change is not material
GEN-CLIMAT-NON-MATERIEL.definition: Only if the company concludes that climate change is not material and so omits all of ESRS E1: the basis for this conclusion (ESRS 2 §37(b)). Answer N/A otherwise.

GEN-IRO-CHANGEMENTS.name: Changes in the material impacts, risks and opportunities
GEN-IRO-CHANGEMENTS.definition: Changes in the material impacts, risks and opportunities compared with the previous period (ESRS 2 §37(c)). Answer N/A if there is none.

GEN-INDEX-EXIGENCES.name: Content index of the disclosure requirements applied
GEN-INDEX-EXIGENCES.definition: List of the disclosure requirements applied in preparing the sustainability statement, with where each disclosure is located, indicating separately those incorporated by reference; a table of the requirements with pages or paragraphs is suitable (ESRS 2 §37(d), AR 29).

GEN-INFOS-SUPPLEMENTAIRES.name: List of supplementary information
GEN-INFOS-SUPPLEMENTAIRES.definition: List of the ‘supplementary’ information disclosed under ESRS 1, section 8.2 (other legislation, other standards or frameworks, non-material information asked for by a user) (ESRS 2 §37(e), AR 29). Answer N/A if there is none.

GEN-RISQUE-TRAVAIL-FORCE.name: Exposure to the risk of forced labour and child labour
GEN-RISQUE-TRAVAIL-FORCE.definition: Only if the company is connected, through its own operations or its value chain, to material negative impacts related to forced or compulsory labour or child labour: its exposure to a heightened risk of incidents, by type of operations (manufacturing plants, for example) or by country or geography (ESRS 2 §37(f)). Answer N/A otherwise.

GEN-INDEX-DONNEES-UE.name: Table of the datapoints derived from other EU legislation
GEN-INDEX-DONNEES-UE.definition: Table of all the datapoints derived from other EU legislation (Appendix A of ESRS 2: SFDR, Pillar 3, Benchmark Regulation, European Climate Law), with where each one is in the sustainability statement or the mention ‘not material’ (ESRS 2 §37(g)).

GEN-SANS-PAT.name: Material topics without policies, actions or targets
GEN-SANS-PAT.definition: Topics related to material impacts, risks or opportunities for which the company has no policies, actions or targets: the standard asks to say so (ESRS 2 §39). They can be marked in the table of impacts, risks and opportunities (AR 31). Answer N/A if there is none.

GEN-SPEC-POLITIQUES.name: Policies adopted on entity-specific matters
GEN-SPEC-POLITIQUES.definition: Has the company adopted policies to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on entity-specific matters? If not, answer No: the standard asks to say so (ESRS 2 §39).

GEN-SPEC-POLIT-CONTENU.name: Policies on entity-specific matters: contents and changes
GEN-SPEC-POLIT-CONTENU.definition: For each policy: its key contents, its general objectives and the material impacts, risks or opportunities it addresses; describe the changes made during the period (ESRS 2 §42(a)).

GEN-SPEC-POLIT-PERIMETRE.name: Policies on entity-specific matters: scope and exclusions
GEN-SPEC-POLIT-PERIMETRE.definition: For each policy: its scope or exclusions (own operations, upstream and downstream value chain, geographies and, if defined, the affected stakeholder groups) (ESRS 2 §42(b)).

GEN-SPEC-POLIT-REFERENCES.name: Policies on entity-specific matters: third-party standards or initiatives
GEN-SPEC-POLIT-REFERENCES.definition: Third-party standards or initiatives that the company commits to respect through its policies (ESRS 2 §42(c)). Answer N/A if no policy refers to one.

GEN-SPEC-POLIT-PARTIES.name: Policies on entity-specific matters: interests of affected stakeholders
GEN-SPEC-POLIT-PARTIES.definition: How the interests of affected stakeholders were considered in setting each policy, if they were (ESRS 2 §42(d)).

GEN-SPEC-ACTIONS.name: Key actions on entity-specific matters
GEN-SPEC-ACTIONS.definition: Has the company taken or planned key actions to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on entity-specific matters? If not, answer No (ESRS 2 §39).

GEN-SPEC-ACT-DESC.name: Key actions on entity-specific matters: description, scope and expected outcomes
GEN-SPEC-ACT-DESC.definition: Key actions taken during the period and planned, with their timeframe, their scope (own operations, value chain, subsidiaries, geographies, stakeholders) and their expected outcomes, and how they serve the policy objectives (ESRS 2 §45).

GEN-SPEC-ACT-TAB.name: Key actions on entity-specific matters: timeframe and financial resources
GEN-SPEC-ACT-TAB.unit: table: Key action, Status, Timeframe, Scope, Capital expenditure of the period, Operating expenditure of the period, Future resources, low estimate, Future resources, high estimate, Depends on preconditions
GEN-SPEC-ACT-TAB.definition: One row per key action: status, timeframe, scope, capital and operating expenditure of the period, range of future resources, and whether the action depends on preconditions (ESRS 2 §45-46). Amounts only when significant resources are allocated. Amounts in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Source: Action plans, budget, accounting (capital and operating expenditure).

GEN-SPEC-ACT-MOYENS.name: Key actions on entity-specific matters: type of resources, preconditions and line items
GEN-SPEC-ACT-MOYENS.definition: When significant financial resources are allocated to the actions: their type (current and future), the preconditions the actions depend on (financial support, public policy, market) and the line items or notes of the financial statements that contain the amounts (ESRS 2 §46).

GEN-SPEC-CIBLES.name: Measurable targets on entity-specific matters
GEN-SPEC-CIBLES.definition: Has the company set measurable, time-bound and outcome-oriented targets on entity-specific matters? If not, answer No and describe below how it tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52).

GEN-SPEC-CIB-TAB.name: Targets on entity-specific matters: values, years and scope
GEN-SPEC-CIB-TAB.unit: table: Target, Metric, Absolute or relative, Unit, Base year, Baseline value, Milestone year, Milestone value, Target year, Target value, Required by law, Based on conclusive scientific evidence, Scope
GEN-SPEC-CIB-TAB.definition: One row per target: metric and unit, absolute or relative target, baseline value and year, milestone, target value and year, whether it is required by law, whether it is based on conclusive scientific evidence (environmental topics), scope (ESRS 2 §51). Source: Company strategy, roadmaps and dashboards.

GEN-SPEC-CIB-DESC.name: Targets on entity-specific matters: link to policies, milestones, methods and scenarios
GEN-SPEC-CIB-DESC.definition: For each target: its link to the policy objectives and actions, the milestones or interim targets, the methods and significant assumptions and, where applicable, the scenarios, the key data sources and the compatibility with national, EU or international policy goals (ESRS 2 §51(a), (e), (f), (h)).

GEN-SPEC-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.name: Tracking of effectiveness without targets on entity-specific matters
GEN-SPEC-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.definition: Only if no measurable target is set: whether and how the company still tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Answer N/A if targets are set.

GEN-SPEC-METHODES.name: Metrics on entity-specific matters: methods, sources, value chain data and context
GEN-SPEC-METHODES.definition: For each metric: unit, calculation method and sources, estimation method with its significant assumptions and limitations; for a value chain metric, reliance on indirect sources or proxies and the planned improvements; contextual information (ESRS 2 §49(a) to (c)).

GEN-SPEC-EVOLUTION.name: Metrics on entity-specific matters: significant changes and progress
GEN-SPEC-EVOLUTION.definition: Significant changes in performance compared with the previous periods, progress towards the targets and effect of major acquisitions or disposals (ESRS 2 §49(d)).

GEN-SPEC-INDICATEURS.name: Entity-specific metrics
GEN-SPEC-INDICATEURS.definition: One row per metric defined by the company for a material topic that the ESRS do not cover, or not with enough granularity: title, value, unit, scope (ESRS 2 §48, AR 42; ESRS 1 §11). A metric to follow by site can also be added as a KPI of the installation. Source: Company dashboards.

GOV-DH-POLITIQUE.name: Overarching human rights policy (UN, ILO, OECD)
GOV-DH-POLITIQUE.definition: Does the company have an overarching human rights policy that commits to implement the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights, the ILO Declaration on Fundamental Principles and Rights at Work and the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises (ESRS 2 §43, AR 34)?

GOV-DH-PERSONNEL.name: Human rights policy: own workforce covered
GOV-DH-PERSONNEL.definition: Does the overarching human rights policy cover the own workforce (ESRS 2 §43)? Answer N/A without such a policy.

GOV-DH-CHAINE.name: Human rights policy: workers in the value chain covered
GOV-DH-CHAINE.definition: Does the overarching human rights policy cover the workers in the value chain (ESRS 2 §43)? Answer N/A without such a policy.

GOV-DH-COMMUNAUTES.name: Human rights policy: affected communities covered
GOV-DH-COMMUNAUTES.definition: Does the overarching human rights policy cover the affected communities (ESRS 2 §43)? Answer N/A without such a policy.

GOV-DH-CONSOMMATEURS.name: Human rights policy: consumers and end-users covered
GOV-DH-CONSOMMATEURS.definition: Does the overarching human rights policy cover the consumers and end-users (ESRS 2 §43)? Answer N/A without such a policy.

GOV-DH-POLIT-DESC.name: Human rights policy: contents, scope and references
GOV-DH-POLIT-DESC.definition: For this policy, the information required for any policy: key contents and changes, scope or exclusions, third-party standards or initiatives, consideration of the interests of stakeholders; also name the other stakeholder groups covered (ESRS 2 §43, §42). Answer N/A without such a policy.

GEN-CHAINE-VALEUR-EFFORTS.name: Efforts to obtain value chain information
GEN-CHAINE-VALEUR-EFFORTS.definition: During the first three reporting years, if not all the necessary information on the value chain is available: efforts made to obtain it, reasons why not all of it could be obtained, and plans to obtain it in the future (ESRS 1 §123). Answer N/A otherwise.

CLI-POLITIQUES.name: Policies adopted on climate change
CLI-POLITIQUES.definition: Has the company adopted policies to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on climate change? If not, answer No: the standard asks to say so (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-POLIT-CONTENU.name: Policies on climate change: contents and changes
CLI-POLIT-CONTENU.definition: For each policy: its key contents, its general objectives and the material impacts, risks or opportunities it addresses; describe the changes made during the period (ESRS 2 §42(a)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-POLIT-PERIMETRE.name: Policies on climate change: scope and exclusions
CLI-POLIT-PERIMETRE.definition: For each policy: its scope or exclusions (own operations, upstream and downstream value chain, geographies and, if defined, the affected stakeholder groups) (ESRS 2 §42(b)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-POLIT-REFERENCES.name: Policies on climate change: third-party standards or initiatives
CLI-POLIT-REFERENCES.definition: Third-party standards or initiatives that the company commits to respect through its policies (ESRS 2 §42(c)). Answer N/A if no policy refers to one. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-ACTIONS.name: Key actions on climate change
CLI-ACTIONS.definition: Has the company taken or planned key actions to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on climate change? If not, answer No (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-ACT-DESC.name: Key actions on climate change: description, scope and expected outcomes
CLI-ACT-DESC.definition: Key actions taken during the period and planned, with their timeframe, their scope (own operations, value chain, subsidiaries, geographies, stakeholders) and their expected outcomes, and how they serve the policy objectives (ESRS 2 §45). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-ACT-TAB.name: Key actions on climate change: timeframe and financial resources
CLI-ACT-TAB.unit: table: Key action, Status, Timeframe, Scope, Capital expenditure of the period, Operating expenditure of the period, Future resources, low estimate, Future resources, high estimate, Depends on preconditions
CLI-ACT-TAB.definition: One row per key action: status, timeframe, scope, capital and operating expenditure of the period, range of future resources, and whether the action depends on preconditions (ESRS 2 §45-46). Amounts only when significant resources are allocated. Amounts in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Action plans, budget, accounting (capital and operating expenditure).

CLI-ACT-MOYENS.name: Key actions on climate change: type of resources, preconditions and line items
CLI-ACT-MOYENS.definition: When significant financial resources are allocated to the actions: their type (current and future), the preconditions the actions depend on (financial support, public policy, market) and the line items or notes of the financial statements that contain the amounts (ESRS 2 §46). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-CIBLES.name: Measurable targets on climate change
CLI-CIBLES.definition: Has the company set measurable, time-bound and outcome-oriented targets on climate change? If not, answer No and describe below how it tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-CIB-TAB.name: Targets on climate change: values, years and scope
CLI-CIB-TAB.unit: table: Target, Metric, Absolute or relative, Unit, Base year, Baseline value, Milestone year, Milestone value, Target year, Target value, Required by law, Based on conclusive scientific evidence, Scope
CLI-CIB-TAB.definition: One row per target: metric and unit, absolute or relative target, baseline value and year, milestone, target value and year, whether it is required by law, whether it is based on conclusive scientific evidence (environmental topics), scope (ESRS 2 §51). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Company strategy, roadmaps and dashboards.

CLI-CIB-DESC.name: Targets on climate change: link to policies, milestones, methods and scenarios
CLI-CIB-DESC.definition: For each target: its link to the policy objectives and actions, the milestones or interim targets, the methods and significant assumptions and, where applicable, the scenarios, the key data sources and the compatibility with national, EU or international policy goals (ESRS 2 §51(a), (e), (f), (h)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.name: Tracking of effectiveness without targets on climate change
CLI-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.definition: Only if no measurable target is set: whether and how the company still tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Answer N/A if targets are set. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-METHODES.name: Metrics on climate change: methods, sources, value chain data and context
CLI-METHODES.definition: For each metric: unit, calculation method and sources, estimation method with its significant assumptions and limitations; for a value chain metric, reliance on indirect sources or proxies and the planned improvements; contextual information (ESRS 2 §49(a) to (c)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-EVOLUTION.name: Metrics on climate change: significant changes and progress
CLI-EVOLUTION.definition: Significant changes in performance compared with the previous periods, progress towards the targets and effect of major acquisitions or disposals (ESRS 2 §49(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-PLAN-TRANSITION.name: Transition plan for climate change mitigation: key features
CLI-PLAN-TRANSITION.definition: Key features of the plan: GHG emission reduction targets, decarbonisation levers, key actions, investments and funding needed, approval by the administrative, management and supervisory bodies, and how the plan is embedded in the company's strategy. Say how the strategy and business model are or will be compatible with limiting global warming to 1.5 °C and with EU climate neutrality by 2050, with references to the E1-5 and E1-6 disclosures; say whether the plan also covers adaptation (ESRS E1, §12(a); AR 1, AR 2). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Transition plan, climate strategy, decisions of the administrative body.

CLI-CAPEX-CHARBON.name: CapEx related to coal
CLI-CAPEX-CHARBON.definition: Capital expenditure of the period in economic activities related to coal (ESRS E1, §12(b)). Activities named in the footnote of the regulation: mining of coal and lignite, extraction of crude petroleum and support activities, coke and refined petroleum products, electric power generation and distribution, coal-fired or oil-fired steam or heat supply, wholesale of solid and liquid fuels (NACE B.05, B.06, B.09.1, C.19, D.35.1, D.35.3, D.46.81). Only if the company has such expenditure; otherwise, answer N/A. Amount in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50): the unit follows the reference currency of the space (Frameworks › Units and formats), to set before you install the template; no value is converted. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounting, financial statements, management control.

CLI-CAPEX-PETROLE.name: CapEx related to oil
CLI-CAPEX-PETROLE.definition: Capital expenditure of the period in economic activities related to oil (ESRS E1, §12(b)). Activities named in the footnote of the regulation: mining of coal and lignite, extraction of crude petroleum and support activities, coke and refined petroleum products, electric power generation and distribution, coal-fired or oil-fired steam or heat supply, wholesale of solid and liquid fuels (NACE B.05, B.06, B.09.1, C.19, D.35.1, D.35.3, D.46.81). Only if the company has such expenditure; otherwise, answer N/A. Amount in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50): the unit follows the reference currency of the space (Frameworks › Units and formats), to set before you install the template; no value is converted. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounting, financial statements, management control.

CLI-CAPEX-GAZ.name: CapEx related to gas
CLI-CAPEX-GAZ.definition: Capital expenditure of the period in economic activities related to gas (ESRS E1, §12(b)). Activities named in the footnote of the regulation: mining of coal and lignite, extraction of crude petroleum and support activities, coke and refined petroleum products, electric power generation and distribution, coal-fired or oil-fired steam or heat supply, wholesale of solid and liquid fuels (NACE B.05, B.06, B.09.1, C.19, D.35.1, D.35.3, D.46.81). Only if the company has such expenditure; otherwise, answer N/A. Amount in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50): the unit follows the reference currency of the space (Frameworks › Units and formats), to set before you install the template; no value is converted. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounting, financial statements, management control.

CLI-PLAN-HYPOTHESES.name: Transition plan: key assumptions and dependencies
CLI-PLAN-HYPOTHESES.definition: Key assumptions of the plan (changes in regulation, ability to change the value chain…) and the dependencies it relies on (deployment of technologies, availability of workforce, future financial resources) (ESRS E1, §12(c); AR 3). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Transition plan, climate strategy, decisions of the administrative body.

CLI-PLAN-VERROUILLAGE.name: Transition plan: locked-in emissions of key assets and products
CLI-PLAN-VERROUILLAGE.definition: Qualitative assessment: how the GHG emissions potentially locked in by the key physical assets and products may put the plan at risk and drive transition risk, according to their size (ESRS E1, §12(d); AR 4). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Transition plan, climate strategy, decisions of the administrative body.

CLI-PLAN-AVANCEMENT.name: Transition plan: progress in implementation
CLI-PLAN-AVANCEMENT.definition: Progress in implementing the plan, with quantitative and qualitative elements: resources deployed (amounts), actions taken, emission reductions achieved or expected and, where applicable, sector-specific metrics to track the targets (ESRS E1, §12(e); AR 5). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Transition plan, climate strategy, decisions of the administrative body.

CLI-RISQUES-TAB.name: Material climate-related risks: physical or transition risk
CLI-RISQUES-TAB.definition: One row per material climate-related risk identified by the materiality assessment (ESRS 2 IRO-2): the risk, and whether it is classified as a physical risk or a transition risk (ESRS E1, §15). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Risk map, climate scenario analysis, vulnerability studies of the sites.

CLI-METHODE-ALEAS.name: Method to assess exposure to climate-related hazards
CLI-METHODE-ALEAS.definition: Key elements of the method that assesses how the assets and business activities (own operations, upstream and downstream value chain) may be exposed and sensitive to climate-related hazards over the short, medium and long term: hazards identified, screening of assets, locations, likelihood, magnitude and duration (ESRS E1, §16(a); AR 6). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Risk map, climate scenario analysis, vulnerability studies of the sites.

CLI-METHODE-TRANSITION.name: Method to assess exposure to transition events
CLI-METHODE-TRANSITION.definition: Key elements of the method that assesses how the assets and business activities (own operations, upstream and downstream value chain) may be exposed and sensitive to climate-related transition events and trends (policy, technology, market, reputation) over the short, medium and long term (ESRS E1, §16(b); AR 6). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Risk map, climate scenario analysis, vulnerability studies of the sites.

CLI-SCENARIOS-UTILISES.name: Climate-related scenario analysis used
CLI-SCENARIOS-UTILISES.definition: Does the company use climate-related scenario analysis to identify and assess its climate-related risks? If not, answer N/A to the next E1-2 questions on scenarios (ESRS E1, §17; AR 6). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-SCENARIOS.name: Climate-related scenarios applied
CLI-SCENARIOS.definition: Only if scenario analysis is used: the range of climate-related scenarios applied (names, sources, for example IPCC or IEA scenarios) (ESRS E1, §17(a)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-SCEN-EMISSIONS-ELEVEES.name: High-emission scenario used for physical risks
CLI-SCEN-EMISSIONS-ELEVEES.definition: Only if scenario analysis is used: was at least one high-emission scenario used to assess the physical risks (ESRS E1, §17(a)(i))? Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-SCEN-1-5.name: 1.5 °C scenario used for transition risks
CLI-SCEN-1-5.definition: Only if scenario analysis is used: was at least one scenario in line with limiting global warming to 1.5 °C, with no or limited overshoot, used to assess the transition risks (ESRS E1, §17(a)(ii))? Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-SCEN-TEMPERATURE.name: Scenarios: temperature projections and relevance
CLI-SCEN-TEMPERATURE.definition: Only if scenario analysis is used: the global average temperature projection of each scenario, and why these scenarios are considered relevant (ESRS E1, §17(a)(iii)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-SCEN-PERIMETRE.name: Scenarios: scope of operations
CLI-SCEN-PERIMETRE.definition: Only if scenario analysis is used: the scope of operations used (operating locations, business units, value chain) (ESRS E1, §17(b)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-SCEN-HYPOTHESES.name: Scenarios: key assumptions
CLI-SCEN-HYPOTHESES.definition: Only if scenario analysis is used: key assumptions (public policies, macroeconomic trends, national or regional variables, energy use and mix, technology developments) (ESRS E1, §17(c)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-SCEN-ANNEE.name: Year of the scenario analysis
CLI-SCEN-ANNEE.definition: Only if scenario analysis is used: year when it was carried out (ESRS E1, §17(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Risk map, climate scenario analysis, vulnerability studies of the sites.

CLI-RESILIENCE.name: Climate resilience: results of the analysis
CLI-RESILIENCE.definition: Results of the analysis of the resilience of the strategy and business model to climate-related risks, at the reporting date: implications for the strategy and business model, use of the results of the scenario analysis if any, contribution of the transition plan and of the mitigation and adaptation actions (ESRS E1, §19(a); AR 7 to AR 9). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Risk map, climate scenario analysis, vulnerability studies of the sites.

CLI-RESILIENCE-INCERTITUDES.name: Climate resilience: significant areas of uncertainty
CLI-RESILIENCE-INCERTITUDES.definition: Significant areas of uncertainty in the assessment of climate resilience (ESRS E1, §19(b); AR 7, AR 8). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-RESILIENCE-ADAPTATION.name: Climate resilience: capacity to adapt by time horizon
CLI-RESILIENCE-ADAPTATION.definition: Capacity to adjust or adapt the strategy and business model to climate change over the short, medium and long term: available financial resources, ability to redeploy, upgrade or decommission assets, effect of current and planned investments (ESRS E1, §19(c); AR 10). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-ACTIONS-LEVIERS.name: Mitigation actions by decarbonisation lever
CLI-ACTIONS-LEVIERS.definition: Key mitigation actions, taken and planned, grouped by decarbonisation lever (energy efficiency, material efficiency, fuel switching, electrification, renewable energy, change of product or process…) (ESRS E1, §22(a)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-LEVIERS-TAB.name: GHG emission reductions by decarbonisation lever
CLI-LEVIERS-TAB.unit: table: Decarbonisation lever, Action, Achieved reduction, Expected reduction, Time horizon
CLI-LEVIERS-TAB.definition: One row per lever (or per action of a lever): GHG emission reduction achieved and expected, in tCO2e, with the time horizon (ESRS E1, §22(b); possible presentation with the targets, AR 15). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Transition plan, climate strategy, decisions of the administrative body.

CLI-ZERO-NET-RESIDUEL.name: Net-zero target: neutralisation of residual emissions
CLI-ZERO-NET-RESIDUEL.definition: Only if the company discloses a net-zero target next to its reduction targets: how it intends to permanently neutralise its residual emissions. Otherwise, answer N/A (ESRS E1, AR 11 for §23). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-CIBLES-GES-TAB.name: GHG emission reduction targets
CLI-CIBLES-GES-TAB.unit: table: Target, Scope, Absolute or intensity, Unit, Base year, Baseline value, Milestone year, Milestone value, Target year, Target value, Share of this scope in a combined target (%), Share of the scope inventory covered (%), Gases covered, Entities and areas covered
CLI-CIBLES-GES-TAB.definition: Absolute scope 1 and 2 targets with a single base year and a single target year are entered in “Absolute scope 1 and 2 targets” above, without repeating them here; this table takes the other targets, and a row for the milestone, the share covered or the gases of an absolute target when there are any. One row per target and per scope: scope (1, 2 location-based or market-based, 3, or combined scopes), absolute target (tCO2e) or intensity target (unit of physical activity or economic output), base year and baseline value, milestones, target year and value. For a combined target: the share of each scope (one row per scope). If the scope of the target (areas, gases, entities) differs from the E1-8 inventory: the share of each scope covered and the gases covered. Targets are gross: no removals, carbon credits or avoided emissions. A target set only in intensity also gives its absolute values for the target year and the milestones (ESRS E1, §24(a)-(b); AR 12 to AR 16). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Transition plan, climate strategy, decisions of the administrative body.

CLI-CIBLES-SCIENCE.name: GHG targets science-based and compatible with 1.5 °C
CLI-CIBLES-SCIENCE.definition: Are the GHG emission reduction targets science-based and compatible with limiting global warming to 1.5 °C (ESRS E1, §24(c); AR 17)? Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-CIBLES-REFERENCE.name: GHG targets: framework, method and comparison with 1.5 °C
CLI-CIBLES-REFERENCE.definition: Framework and method used to set the targets, underlying climate and policy scenarios, and comparison of the target values with a 1.5 °C-aligned reference value (scopes 1 and 2, and scope 3 if it has a target), from a sector-specific pathway if one exists, otherwise cross-sector; validation by a third party if any. A target that is not compatible with 1.5 °C is explained here (ESRS E1, §24(c); AR 2(a), AR 17). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-CIBLES-SECTORIEL.name: GHG targets derived from a sectoral decarbonisation pathway
CLI-CIBLES-SECTORIEL.definition: Are the framework and method used to set the GHG targets derived from a sectoral decarbonisation pathway (ESRS E1, §24(c))? Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-CIBLES-EVOLUTIONS.name: GHG targets: future developments considered
CLI-CIBLES-EVOLUTIONS.definition: Among the critical assumptions of the targets: how the company has considered future developments (sales volumes, customer preferences and demand, regulation, new technologies) and their possible effect on its emissions and on its emission reductions (ESRS E1, §24(c)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

NRJ-ACHAT-NUCLEAIRE.name: Purchased energy from nuclear sources
NRJ-ACHAT-NUCLEAIRE.definition: Nuclear part of the electricity, heat, steam and cooling purchased and consumed by the site during the period, in MWh, according to the energy mix of the supplier or, failing that, of the grid (ESRS E1, §26(b); AR 18). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Contracts and certificates of the energy suppliers (energy mix, guarantees of origin), invoices.

NRJ-ACHAT-RENOUV.name: Purchased energy from renewable sources
NRJ-ACHAT-RENOUV.definition: Renewable part of the electricity, heat, steam and cooling purchased and consumed by the site during the period, in MWh. Conservative approach: with the market-based method, only energy whose renewable origin is defined in the contract (power purchase agreement, standardised green tariff, guarantees of origin); say in the methods whether the share comes from the market-based or location-based method (ESRS E1, §26(c); AR 18(i)). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Contracts and certificates of the energy suppliers (energy mix, guarantees of origin), invoices.

NRJ-ACHAT-FOSSILE.name: Purchased energy from fossil sources
NRJ-ACHAT-FOSSILE.definition: Calculated by the tool: purchased electricity, heat, steam and cooling, minus their nuclear and renewable parts, in MWh. Conservative approach: everything that is not shown to be nuclear or renewable counts as fossil (ESRS E1, §27(e); AR 18(i)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

NRJ-FOSSILE.name: Energy consumption from fossil sources
NRJ-FOSSILE.definition: Calculated by the tool: fossil fuels and purchased energy from fossil sources, in MWh (ESRS E1, §26(a)). With nuclear and renewable energy, it makes up the total consumption. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

NRJ-RENOUVELABLE.name: Energy consumption from renewable sources
NRJ-RENOUVELABLE.definition: Calculated by the tool: renewable fuels, self-generated renewable electricity consumed and purchased energy from renewable sources, in MWh (ESRS E1, §26(c); AR 18). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

NRJ-CHARBON.name: Fuel consumption from coal and coal products
NRJ-CHARBON.definition: Coal, lignite, coke and other coal products burned on the site during the period, in MWh on a net calorific value basis. They are part of the “Other fossil fuels” entered in the calculation data (ESRS E1, §27(a)). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Only for a company with operations in high climate impact sectors (NACE sections A to H and L, glossary); otherwise, answer N/A. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Invoices, delivery notes, meters.

NRJ-PETROLE-AUTRES.name: Other petroleum products burned
NRJ-PETROLE-AUTRES.definition: Petroleum products other than heating oil and vehicle fuels (LPG, propane, butane, kerosene, heavy fuel oil…) burned on the site during the period, in MWh on a net calorific value basis. They are part of the “Other fossil fuels” entered in the calculation data (ESRS E1, §27(b)). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Only for a company with operations in high climate impact sectors (NACE sections A to H and L, glossary); otherwise, answer N/A. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Invoices, delivery notes, meters.

NRJ-PETROLE.name: Fuel consumption from crude oil and petroleum products
NRJ-PETROLE.definition: Calculated by the tool: heating oil, diesel and petrol converted into MWh, plus the other petroleum products (ESRS E1, §27(b)). Only for high climate impact sectors. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

NRJ-GAZ-MWH.name: Fuel consumption from natural gas
NRJ-GAZ-MWH.definition: Calculated by the tool: natural gas billed in kWh of gross calorific value, converted into MWh on a net calorific value basis (ESRS E1, §27(c); AR 18(b)). Only for high climate impact sectors. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

NRJ-FOSSILE-AUTRES.name: Fuel consumption from other fossil sources
NRJ-FOSSILE-AUTRES.definition: Calculated by the tool: “Other fossil fuels” of the calculation data, minus coal and the other petroleum products; for example process gas, hydrogen that is not fully renewable (ESRS E1, §27(d); AR 18(h)). Only for high climate impact sectors. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

NRJ-PROD-NON-REN.name: Non-renewable energy production
NRJ-PROD-NON-REN.definition: Energy produced by the site from non-renewable sources during the period (electricity, heat, steam, cooling), whether consumed on site or sold, in MWh. Only if the company produces energy; otherwise, answer N/A (ESRS E1, §28). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Production meters, energy sale contracts.

NRJ-PROD-REN.name: Renewable energy production
NRJ-PROD-REN.definition: Energy produced by the site from renewable sources during the period (solar panels, wind, biomass…), whether consumed on site or sold, in MWh. Only if the company produces energy; otherwise, answer N/A (ESRS E1, §28). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Production meters, energy sale contracts.

GES-S1-BRUT.name: Gross scope 1 GHG emissions
GES-S1-BRUT.definition: Calculated by the tool: stationary and mobile combustion and fugitive emissions, plus the other direct emissions (processes, other fuels, agriculture), in tCO2e, without removals, credits or allowances and without biogenic CO2 (ESRS E1, §30(a)(i); AR 20, AR 21). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GES-S1-SEQE.name: Scope 1 emissions covered by the EU ETS
GES-S1-SEQE.definition: Emissions of the site's installations covered by the EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) during the period, in tCO2e, calculated with the EU ETS method and over the same period as scope 1. Enter 0 for a site without an installation under the EU ETS (ESRS E1, §30(a)(i); AR 21, AR 22). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Verified emissions reports of the EU ETS (Union Registry).

GES-PART-SEQE.name: Share of scope 1 emissions from the EU ETS
GES-PART-SEQE.definition: Calculated by the tool at every level: emissions covered by the EU ETS divided by gross scope 1 emissions (ESRS E1, §30(a)(i); AR 22(c)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GES-S1-HORS-GROUPE.name: Scope 1 outside the consolidated accounting group
GES-S1-HORS-GROUPE.definition: Part of these emissions (gross scope 1) that does not come from the consolidated accounting group (parent and consolidated subsidiaries) but from other operations included in the inventory under the consolidation approach chosen (for example a joint venture under operational control), in tCO2e. Enter 0 if the whole inventory comes from the consolidated group (ESRS E1, §30(c); AR 19). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Greenhouse gas emissions inventory.

GES-S2-LB-HORS-GROUPE.name: Scope 2 (location-based) outside the consolidated accounting group
GES-S2-LB-HORS-GROUPE.definition: Part of these emissions (location-based scope 2) that does not come from the consolidated accounting group (parent and consolidated subsidiaries) but from other operations included in the inventory under the consolidation approach chosen (for example a joint venture under operational control), in tCO2e. Enter 0 if the whole inventory comes from the consolidated group (ESRS E1, §30(c); AR 19). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Greenhouse gas emissions inventory.

GES-S2-MB-HORS-GROUPE.name: Scope 2 (market-based) outside the consolidated accounting group
GES-S2-MB-HORS-GROUPE.definition: Part of these emissions (market-based scope 2) that does not come from the consolidated accounting group (parent and consolidated subsidiaries) but from other operations included in the inventory under the consolidation approach chosen (for example a joint venture under operational control), in tCO2e. Enter 0 if the whole inventory comes from the consolidated group (ESRS E1, §30(c); AR 19). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Greenhouse gas emissions inventory.

GES-S1-GROUPE.name: Scope 1 of the consolidated accounting group
GES-S1-GROUPE.definition: Calculated by the tool: gross scope 1 emissions minus the part outside the consolidated accounting group, in tCO2e (ESRS E1, §30(c)(i)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GES-S2-LB-GROUPE.name: Scope 2 (location-based) of the consolidated accounting group
GES-S2-LB-GROUPE.definition: Calculated by the tool: location-based scope 2 emissions minus the part outside the consolidated accounting group, in tCO2e (ESRS E1, §30(c)(i)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GES-S2-MB-GROUPE.name: Scope 2 (market-based) of the consolidated accounting group
GES-S2-MB-GROUPE.definition: Calculated by the tool: market-based scope 2 emissions minus the part outside the consolidated accounting group, in tCO2e (ESRS E1, §30(c)(i)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GES-S3-TOTAL.name: Gross scope 3 GHG emissions
GES-S3-TOTAL.definition: Calculated by the tool: sum of the significant scope 3 categories, in tCO2e. Enter the emissions of each significant category (by size and the GHG Protocol criteria); a category that is not significant gets N/A: it counts as 0 in this total (“an N/A source counts as 0” box of the KPI sheet, ticked at installation) and is not disclosed as zero (ESRS E1, §30(a)(iii); AR 24, AR 26). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GES-S3-CLOUD.name: Scope 3 – of which cloud computing and data centre services
GES-S3-CLOUD.definition: Part of scope 3 category 1 (purchased goods and services) due to purchased cloud computing and data centre services, in tCO2e. Only if applicable; otherwise, answer N/A (ESRS E1, AR 24(g); AR 26). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Greenhouse gas emissions inventory.

GES-BIOGENIQUE.name: Direct biogenic CO2 emissions
GES-BIOGENIQUE.definition: CO2 emitted by the combustion or biodegradation of biomass on the site during the period (wood, pellets, biogas, biofuels), in tonnes, separately from scope 1; the CH4 and N2O of these combustions stay in scope 1 (ESRS E1, §31; AR 20(e)). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Greenhouse gas emissions inventory.

CLI-METHODE-GES.name: GHG emissions and energy: measurement approach
CLI-METHODE-GES.definition: Measurement approach of the emissions: boundary and consolidation approach (financial control by default, or equity share, or operational control), standards followed (GHG Protocol, ISO 14064-1), global warming potentials used, emission factors and their sources, contractual instruments of market-based scope 2, EU ETS method, update of scope 3; for energy, method (market-based or location-based) of the renewable share of purchased energy and treatment of purchased steam (ESRS E1, §30(b); AR 18(i), AR 19, AR 20, AR 23, AR 24). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-ABSORPTIONS.name: GHG removal and storage projects
CLI-ABSORPTIONS.definition: Has the company implemented GHG removal and storage projects, in its own operations or by contributing to them in its value chain? If not, answer N/A to the next questions on the projects (ESRS E1, §33; AR 27). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-ABSORPTIONS-PROJETS.name: GHG removal and storage projects: description
CLI-ABSORPTIONS-PROJETS.definition: Short description of each GHG removal and storage project, nature-based or technological (ESRS E1, §33(a); AR 27). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-ABSORPTIONS-TAB.name: GHG removals and storage by project
CLI-ABSORPTIONS-TAB.unit: table: Project, Type (nature-based, technological), Removals and storage
CLI-ABSORPTIONS-TAB.definition: One row per project: GHG removals and storage it produced during the period, in tCO2e, with a recognised method (for example Regulation (EU) 2024/3012), without the removals sold as carbon credits (ESRS E1, §33(b); AR 27). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Project monitoring, certification records.

CLI-ABSORPTIONS-PERMANENCE.name: Removals: management of the risk of non-permanence
CLI-ABSORPTIONS-PERMANENCE.definition: How the risk of non-permanence is managed: assumptions, detection and monitoring of leakage and reversals (ESRS E1, §33(c); AR 27). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GES-INVERSIONS.name: Reversals of GHG removals
GES-INVERSIONS.definition: GHG removed and stored that were released again during the period (fire, leakage…), in tCO2e; they reduce the CO2 removed and stored by the same amount. Only if there are removal projects; otherwise, answer N/A (ESRS E1, §33(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Monitoring of the removal projects.

GES-CREDITS-ANNULES.name: Carbon credits verified and cancelled
GES-CREDITS-ANNULES.definition: Carbon credits from projects outside the own operations and value chain, verified against a recognised quality standard and cancelled during the period, in tCO2e (ESRS E1, §34(a); AR 28). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Purchase contracts, cancellation certificates of the carbon credit registries.

GES-CREDITS-A-ANNULER.name: Carbon credits purchased not yet cancelled
GES-CREDITS-A-ANNULER.definition: Carbon credits purchased during the period and not cancelled yet at the reporting date, in tCO2e (ESRS E1, §34(b)). For credits purchased under a contract that covers several years, count the sum of the credits still to be cancelled over the duration of the contract (AR 28(c)); a contract signed for future purchases does not count until the credits are purchased. Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Purchase contracts, cancellation certificates of the carbon credit registries.

GES-PART-CREDITS-ABSORPTION.name: Share of carbon credits from removal projects
GES-PART-CREDITS-ABSORPTION.definition: Share, by volume, of the company's carbon credits that come from removal projects (and not from emission reduction projects) (ESRS E1, §34(c)). Say in the next text whether they come from nature-based or technological sinks. Answer N/A if there are no carbon credits. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Purchase contracts, cancellation certificates of the carbon credit registries.

CLI-CREDITS-PUITS.name: Carbon credits: nature-based or technological sinks
CLI-CREDITS-PUITS.definition: For the credits from removal projects: do they come from nature-based or technological sinks (ESRS E1, §34(c))? Answer N/A if there are none. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-NEUTRALITE.name: Public claims of GHG neutrality based on carbon credits
CLI-NEUTRALITE.definition: Has the company made public claims of GHG neutrality that involve carbon credits? If not, answer N/A to the next two questions (ESRS E1, §35). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-NEUTRALITE-CIBLES.name: Neutrality claims and achievement of the GHG targets
CLI-NEUTRALITE-CIBLES.definition: Whether and how these claims and the reliance on carbon credits neither hinder nor undermine the achievement of the GHG emission reduction targets (ESRS E1, §35(a)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-CREDITS-QUALITE.name: Carbon credits: credibility and integrity
CLI-CREDITS-QUALITE.definition: Credibility and integrity of the carbon credits used or planned: recognised quality standards and other useful elements (ESRS E1, §35(b)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-PRIX-CARBONE.name: Internal carbon pricing applied
CLI-PRIX-CARBONE.definition: Does the company apply internal carbon pricing in its decisions? If not, answer No; the next question gets N/A (ESRS E1, §37(a)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-PRIX-CARBONE-DESC.name: Internal carbon pricing: uses and consistency with the financial statements
CLI-PRIX-CARBONE-DESC.definition: How internal carbon pricing is used in decisions (investments, transfer pricing, scenario analysis…), and consistency of the prices used with those of the impairment tests of the financial statements (ESRS E1, §37(a)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-PRIX-CARBONE-TAB.name: Average carbon price by internal pricing scheme
CLI-PRIX-CARBONE-TAB.unit: table: Scheme, Use, Average price per tonne of CO2e
CLI-PRIX-CARBONE-TAB.definition: One row per internal carbon pricing scheme (shadow price, internal fee…): its use and its average price per tonne of GHG, in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS E1, §37(b); ESRS 1 AR 50). Leave empty without internal pricing. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Investment procedures, management control.

CLI-ACTIFS-RISQUE-PHYS.name: Assets at material physical risk
CLI-ACTIFS-RISQUE-PHYS.unit: table: Time horizon, Amount (or low end of the range), High end of the range, Comment
CLI-ACTIFS-RISQUE-PHYS.definition: Carrying amount of the assets at material physical risk, before adaptation actions, at the reporting date and consistent with the financial statements (ESRS E1, §39(a); AR 29). One row per time horizon (short, medium, long term), a single amount or a range (E1 AR 29), in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounting, financial statements, management control.

CLI-PART-ACTIFS-ADAPT.name: Share of assets at physical risk addressed by adaptation
CLI-PART-ACTIFS-ADAPT.definition: Share of the carrying amount of the assets at material physical risk addressed by adaptation actions at the reporting date (ESRS E1, §39(b); AR 29). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounting, financial statements, management control.

CLI-CA-RISQUE-PHYS.name: Net revenue from activities at material physical risk
CLI-CA-RISQUE-PHYS.unit: table: Time horizon, Amount (or low end of the range), High end of the range, Comment
CLI-CA-RISQUE-PHYS.definition: Net revenue of the period from business activities at material physical risk; say in the comment whether it is assessed before or after mitigation actions (ESRS E1, §39(c); AR 29, AR 30). One row per time horizon (short, medium, long term), a single amount or a range (E1 AR 29), in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125-127): a wave-one company may omit this amount for financial years before 2030, another company for its first four financial years of reporting. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounting, financial statements, management control.

CLI-ACTIFS-RISQUE-TRANS.name: Assets at material transition risk
CLI-ACTIFS-RISQUE-TRANS.unit: table: Time horizon, Amount (or low end of the range), High end of the range, Comment
CLI-ACTIFS-RISQUE-TRANS.definition: Carrying amount of the assets at material transition risk, at the reporting date; say in the comment whether it is assessed before or after mitigation actions (ESRS E1, §40(a); AR 29, AR 30). One row per time horizon (short, medium, long term), a single amount or a range (E1 AR 29), in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounting, financial statements, management control.

CLI-ACTIFS-ECHOUES.name: Potential stranded assets (1.5 °C scenario)
CLI-ACTIFS-ECHOUES.unit: table: Time horizon, Amount (or low end of the range), High end of the range, Comment
CLI-ACTIFS-ECHOUES.definition: Estimated range of potential stranded assets, from the reporting year until the medium and long term, based on a scenario aligned with limiting global warming to 1.5 °C: one row for the medium term, one for the long term, in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS E1, §40(a); AR 29, AR 30; ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounting, financial statements, management control.

CLI-PART-ACTIFS-ATTEN.name: Share of assets at transition risk addressed by mitigation
CLI-PART-ACTIFS-ATTEN.definition: Share of the carrying amount of the assets at material transition risk addressed by mitigation actions (ESRS E1, §40(b); AR 29). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounting, financial statements, management control.

CLI-IMMO-GARANTIES.name: Real estate used as loan collateral, by energy-efficiency class
CLI-IMMO-GARANTIES.unit: table: Energy-efficiency class (EPC or kWh/m²), Carrying amount
CLI-IMMO-GARANTIES.definition: One row per energy-efficiency class (Energy Performance Certificate label or range of energy consumption in kWh/m²): carrying amount of the company's real estate assets used as loan collateral. For a financial institution, this also covers the loans collateralised by real estate, broken down by the energy-efficiency class of the collateral (Pillar 3 template 2, Article 449a of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013, to which the footnote of §40(c) refers). If the class cannot be obtained without undue cost or effort, a row “internal estimates” with the carrying amount of the assets whose consumption is estimated (ESRS E1, §40(c); AR 29(e)). Amounts in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125-127): a wave-one company may omit this amount for financial years before 2030, another company for its first four financial years of reporting. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Fixed asset accounting, loan agreements, Energy Performance Certificates.

CLI-PASSIFS-POTENTIELS.name: Potential climate transition liabilities not recognised
CLI-PASSIFS-POTENTIELS.definition: Estimated liabilities related to the climate transition that do not meet the accounting recognition criteria at the reporting date but may have to be recognised later; refer to the financial statements if they mention them (ESRS E1, §40(d); AR 31). Amount in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50): the unit follows the reference currency of the space (Frameworks › Units and formats), to set before you install the template; no value is converted. Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125-127): a wave-one company may omit this amount for financial years before 2030, another company for its first four financial years of reporting. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounting, financial statements, management control.

CLI-CA-RISQUE-TRANS.name: Net revenue from activities at material transition risk
CLI-CA-RISQUE-TRANS.unit: table: Time horizon, Amount (or low end of the range), High end of the range, Comment
CLI-CA-RISQUE-TRANS.definition: Net revenue of the period from business activities at material transition risk; say in the comment whether it is assessed before or after mitigation actions (ESRS E1, §40(e); AR 29, AR 30). One row per time horizon (short, medium, long term), a single amount or a range (E1 AR 29), in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125-127): a wave-one company may omit this amount for financial years before 2030, another company for its first four financial years of reporting.
