Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounting, financial statements, management control.

CLI-CA-CLIENTS-FOSSILES.name: Net revenue from customers in coal, oil and gas activities
CLI-CA-CLIENTS-FOSSILES.unit: table: Time horizon, Amount (or low end of the range), High end of the range, Comment
CLI-CA-CLIENTS-FOSSILES.definition: Net revenue of the period from customers operating in coal-, oil- or gas-related activities, if any; otherwise, leave empty (ESRS E1, §40(e); AR 29, AR 30). One row per time horizon (short, medium, long term), a single amount or a range (E1 AR 29), in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125-127): a wave-one company may omit this amount for financial years before 2030, another company for its first four financial years of reporting. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounting, financial statements, management control.

CLI-EFFETS-METHODE.name: Anticipated financial effects: method
CLI-EFFETS-METHODE.definition: Method that quantifies the amounts of the physical and transition risks (E1-11): scope of the calculation, critical assumptions, parameters and limitations, and, where relevant, the location of the assets at material physical risk, aggregated faithfully (ESRS E1, §41; AR 29, AR 32). Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125-127): a wave-one company may omit this information for financial years before 2028, another company for its first two financial years of reporting. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-EFFETS-SCENARIOS.name: Financial effects quantified from the transition risk assessment
CLI-EFFETS-SCENARIOS.definition: Does the calculation of the anticipated financial effects rely on the process that identifies and assesses the transition risks (for example scenario analysis) (ESRS E1, §41)? Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125-127): a wave-one company may omit this information for financial years before 2028, another company for its first two financial years of reporting. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

CLI-ACTIFS-OPPORTUNITES.name: Assets related to climate opportunities
CLI-ACTIFS-OPPORTUNITES.unit: table: Time horizon, Amount (or low end of the range), High end of the range, Comment
CLI-ACTIFS-OPPORTUNITES.definition: Amount of the assets of business activities related to the identified climate-related opportunities (ESRS E1, §42; AR 29). One row per time horizon (short, medium, long term), a single amount or a range (E1 AR 29), in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125-127): a wave-one company may omit this amount for financial years before 2030, another company for its first four financial years of reporting. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounting, financial statements, management control.

CLI-CA-OPPORTUNITES.name: Revenue related to climate opportunities
CLI-CA-OPPORTUNITES.unit: table: Time horizon, Amount (or low end of the range), High end of the range, Comment
CLI-CA-OPPORTUNITES.definition: Net revenue of the period from business activities related to the identified climate-related opportunities (ESRS E1, §42; AR 29). One row per time horizon (short, medium, long term), a single amount or a range (E1 AR 29), in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125-127): a wave-one company may omit this amount for financial years before 2030, another company for its first four financial years of reporting. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounting, financial statements, management control.

POL-POLITIQUES.name: Policies adopted on pollution
POL-POLITIQUES.definition: Has the company adopted policies to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on pollution? If not, answer No: the standard asks to say so (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

POL-POLIT-CONTENU.name: Policies on pollution: contents and changes
POL-POLIT-CONTENU.definition: For each policy: its key contents, its general objectives and the material impacts, risks or opportunities it addresses; describe the changes made during the period (ESRS 2 §42(a)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

POL-POLIT-PERIMETRE.name: Policies on pollution: scope and exclusions
POL-POLIT-PERIMETRE.definition: For each policy: its scope or exclusions (own operations, upstream and downstream value chain, geographies and, if defined, the affected stakeholder groups) (ESRS 2 §42(b)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

POL-POLIT-REFERENCES.name: Policies on pollution: third-party standards or initiatives
POL-POLIT-REFERENCES.definition: Third-party standards or initiatives that the company commits to respect through its policies (ESRS 2 §42(c)). Answer N/A if no policy refers to one. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

POL-ACTIONS.name: Key actions on pollution
POL-ACTIONS.definition: Has the company taken or planned key actions to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on pollution? If not, answer No (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

POL-ACT-DESC.name: Key actions on pollution: description, scope and expected outcomes
POL-ACT-DESC.definition: Key actions taken during the period and planned, with their timeframe, their scope (own operations, value chain, subsidiaries, geographies, stakeholders) and their expected outcomes, and how they serve the policy objectives (ESRS 2 §45). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

POL-ACT-TAB.name: Key actions on pollution: timeframe and financial resources
POL-ACT-TAB.unit: table: Key action, Status, Timeframe, Scope, Capital expenditure of the period, Operating expenditure of the period, Future resources, low estimate, Future resources, high estimate, Depends on preconditions
POL-ACT-TAB.definition: One row per key action: status, timeframe, scope, capital and operating expenditure of the period, range of future resources, and whether the action depends on preconditions (ESRS 2 §45-46). Amounts only when significant resources are allocated. Amounts in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Action plans, budget, accounting (capital and operating expenditure).

POL-ACT-MOYENS.name: Key actions on pollution: type of resources, preconditions and line items
POL-ACT-MOYENS.definition: When significant financial resources are allocated to the actions: their type (current and future), the preconditions the actions depend on (financial support, public policy, market) and the line items or notes of the financial statements that contain the amounts (ESRS 2 §46). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

POL-CIBLES.name: Measurable targets on pollution
POL-CIBLES.definition: Has the company set measurable, time-bound and outcome-oriented targets on pollution? If not, answer No and describe below how it tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

POL-CIB-TAB.name: Targets on pollution: values, years and scope
POL-CIB-TAB.unit: table: Target, Metric, Absolute or relative, Unit, Base year, Baseline value, Milestone year, Milestone value, Target year, Target value, Required by law, Based on conclusive scientific evidence, Scope
POL-CIB-TAB.definition: One row per target: metric and unit, absolute or relative target, baseline value and year, milestone, target value and year, whether it is required by law, whether it is based on conclusive scientific evidence (environmental topics), scope (ESRS 2 §51). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Company strategy, roadmaps and dashboards.

POL-CIB-DESC.name: Targets on pollution: link to policies, milestones, methods and scenarios
POL-CIB-DESC.definition: For each target: its link to the policy objectives and actions, the milestones or interim targets, the methods and significant assumptions and, where applicable, the scenarios, the key data sources and the compatibility with national, EU or international policy goals (ESRS 2 §51(a), (e), (f), (h)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

POL-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.name: Tracking of effectiveness without targets on pollution
POL-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.definition: Only if no measurable target is set: whether and how the company still tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Answer N/A if targets are set. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

POL-METHODES.name: Metrics on pollution: methods, sources, value chain data and context
POL-METHODES.definition: For each metric: unit, calculation method and sources, estimation method with its significant assumptions and limitations; for a value chain metric, reliance on indirect sources or proxies and the planned improvements; contextual information (ESRS 2 §49(a) to (c)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

POL-EVOLUTION.name: Metrics on pollution: significant changes and progress
POL-EVOLUTION.definition: Significant changes in performance compared with the previous periods, progress towards the targets and effect of major acquisitions or disposals (ESRS 2 §49(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

POL-EMISSIONS.name: Material emissions of pollutants of the European list
POL-EMISSIONS.unit: table: Pollutant, Emissions to air, Emissions to water, Emissions to soil
POL-EMISSIONS.definition: One row per pollutant of the European list (E-PRTR register) whose emissions are material to the company: its emissions to air, water and soil in kg over the period, environmental accidents included (E2-4 §15, E2 AR 1, AR 2). An emission is material by managerial assessment, which considers the activities and the sector; the release thresholds of Annex II to Regulation (EU) 2024/1244 can help. Greenhouse gases belong to ESRS E1. Answer N/A if there is no material emission. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Annual emissions report, measurements and balances of the site.

POL-EMISSIONS-AUTRES.name: Material emissions of other pollutants
POL-EMISSIONS-AUTRES.unit: table: Pollutant, Emissions to air, Emissions to water, Emissions to soil
POL-EMISSIONS-AUTRES.definition: One row per pollutant that is not in the European list and whose emissions are material: its name and its emissions to air, water and soil in kg over the period, environmental accidents included (E2-4 §15, E2 AR 1). The pollutants that the company measures or monitors are an input to assess which emissions are material (E2 AR 2): only material emissions are reported here. Transfers of water pollutants to an external treatment plant, when they are material, are described as an entity-specific disclosure (E2 AR 3). Answer N/A if there are none. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Annual emissions report, measurements and balances of the site.

POL-MICROPLASTIQUES.name: Primary microplastics manufactured or used
POL-MICROPLASTIQUES.definition: Weight of primary microplastics manufactured by the company or used in its products during the period, in kilograms (E2-4 §16, E2 AR 1). A primary microplastic is a synthetic polymer microparticle that is intentionally produced and added to a product (microbeads, glitter, stabilisers). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Bills of materials, material technical sheets, REACH registrations.

POL-MICROPLASTIQUES-REJETS.name: Primary microplastics released into the environment
POL-MICROPLASTIQUES-REJETS.definition: Weight of primary microplastics released directly into the environment during the period, in kilograms (E2-4 §16, E2 AR 1), disclosed separately from the microplastics manufactured or used. Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Annual emissions report, measurements and balances of the site.

POL-SOC-ACHETEES.name: Substances of concern procured
POL-SOC-ACHETEES.definition: Total weight of substances of concern procured by the entity during the period, in tonnes, on their own or in mixtures (E2-5 §18(a), E2 AR 5, AR 6). Substances of concern: substances of very high concern and substances classified in the most serious hazard categories of the CLP regulation (carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive toxicity, endocrine disruption, persistence and bioaccumulation, sensitisation, hazard to the aquatic environment or the ozone layer, target organ toxicity); full list in the glossary of the ESRS. Only for an entity that manufactures, formulates or imports substances (chemical sector, E2 AR 4): enter 0 if there is none; any other entity answers N/A. Phase-in: these amounts may be omitted for financial years starting before 2030 by a wave-one company, and for the first three financial years of reporting by any other company (ESRS 1 §125(d), §126(d), §127(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Chemical substances register, REACH registrations, material accounts of the entity.

POL-SOC-FABRIQUEES.name: Substances of concern manufactured
POL-SOC-FABRIQUEES.definition: Total weight of substances of concern manufactured by the entity during the period, in tonnes, on their own or in mixtures (E2-5 §18(b), E2 AR 5, AR 6). Substances of concern: substances of very high concern and substances classified in the most serious hazard categories of the CLP regulation (carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive toxicity, endocrine disruption, persistence and bioaccumulation, sensitisation, hazard to the aquatic environment or the ozone layer, target organ toxicity); full list in the glossary of the ESRS. Only for an entity that manufactures, formulates or imports substances (chemical sector, E2 AR 4): enter 0 if there is none; any other entity answers N/A. Phase-in: these amounts may be omitted for financial years starting before 2030 by a wave-one company, and for the first three financial years of reporting by any other company (ESRS 1 §125(d), §126(d), §127(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Chemical substances register, REACH registrations, material accounts of the entity.

POL-SOC-MISES-MARCHE.name: Substances of concern placed on the market
POL-SOC-MISES-MARCHE.definition: Total weight of substances of concern placed on the market by the entity during the period, in tonnes, on their own or in mixtures (E2-5 §18(c), E2 AR 5, AR 6). Substances of concern: substances of very high concern and substances classified in the most serious hazard categories of the CLP regulation (carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive toxicity, endocrine disruption, persistence and bioaccumulation, sensitisation, hazard to the aquatic environment or the ozone layer, target organ toxicity); full list in the glossary of the ESRS. Only for an entity that manufactures, formulates or imports substances (chemical sector, E2 AR 4): enter 0 if there is none; any other entity answers N/A. Phase-in: these amounts may be omitted for financial years starting before 2030 by a wave-one company, and for the first three financial years of reporting by any other company (ESRS 1 §125(d), §126(d), §127(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Chemical substances register, REACH registrations, material accounts of the entity.

POL-SOC-REJETEES.name: Substances of concern directly released into the environment
POL-SOC-REJETEES.definition: Total weight of substances of concern directly released into the environment (air, water, soil), unintentional leaks and spills included by the entity during the period, in tonnes, on their own or in mixtures (E2-5 §18(d), E2 AR 5, AR 6). Substances of concern: substances of very high concern and substances classified in the most serious hazard categories of the CLP regulation (carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive toxicity, endocrine disruption, persistence and bioaccumulation, sensitisation, hazard to the aquatic environment or the ozone layer, target organ toxicity); full list in the glossary of the ESRS. Only for an entity that manufactures, formulates or imports substances (chemical sector, E2 AR 4): enter 0 if there is none; any other entity answers N/A. Phase-in: these amounts may be omitted for financial years starting before 2030 by a wave-one company, and for the first three financial years of reporting by any other company (ESRS 1 §125(d), §126(d), §127(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Chemical substances register, REACH registrations, material accounts of the entity.

POL-SVHC-ACHETEES.name: Substances of very high concern procured
POL-SVHC-ACHETEES.definition: Total weight of substances of very high concern procured on their own or in mixtures by the entity during the period, in tonnes (E2-5 §18(a), E2 AR 5, AR 6). A substance that falls in several hazard classes is counted once in this total (no double counting). Substances of very high concern: substances that meet the criteria of Article 57 of the REACH regulation and are identified under its Article 59(1) (candidate list). Only for an entity that manufactures, formulates or imports substances (chemical sector, E2 AR 4): enter 0 if there is none; any other entity answers N/A. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Chemical substances register, REACH registrations, material accounts of the entity.

POL-SVHC-FABRIQUEES.name: Substances of very high concern manufactured
POL-SVHC-FABRIQUEES.definition: Total weight of substances of very high concern manufactured on their own or in mixtures by the entity during the period, in tonnes (E2-5 §18(b), E2 AR 5, AR 6). A substance that falls in several hazard classes is counted once in this total (no double counting). Substances of very high concern: substances that meet the criteria of Article 57 of the REACH regulation and are identified under its Article 59(1) (candidate list). Only for an entity that manufactures, formulates or imports substances (chemical sector, E2 AR 4): enter 0 if there is none; any other entity answers N/A. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Chemical substances register, REACH registrations, material accounts of the entity.

POL-SVHC-MISES-MARCHE.name: Substances of very high concern placed on the market
POL-SVHC-MISES-MARCHE.definition: Total weight of substances of very high concern placed on the market on their own or in mixtures by the entity during the period, in tonnes (E2-5 §18(c), E2 AR 5, AR 6). A substance that falls in several hazard classes is counted once in this total (no double counting). Substances of very high concern: substances that meet the criteria of Article 57 of the REACH regulation and are identified under its Article 59(1) (candidate list). Only for an entity that manufactures, formulates or imports substances (chemical sector, E2 AR 4): enter 0 if there is none; any other entity answers N/A. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Chemical substances register, REACH registrations, material accounts of the entity.

POL-SVHC-REJETEES.name: Substances of very high concern directly released into the environment
POL-SVHC-REJETEES.definition: Total weight of substances of very high concern directly released into the environment (air, water, soil) by the entity during the period, in tonnes, unintentional leaks and spills included (E2-5 §18(d) for a manufacturer, formulator or importer, §19(b) for a user: it is the same quantity and a company is one or the other, E2 AR 4, AR 5, AR 6). No double counting between hazard classes. Substances of very high concern: substances that meet the criteria of Article 57 of the REACH regulation and are identified under its Article 59(1) (candidate list). Only for an entity that manufactures, formulates, imports or uses substances: enter 0 if there is none; any other entity answers N/A. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Chemical substances register, REACH registrations, material accounts of the entity.

POL-SVHC-UTILISEES.name: Substances of very high concern used
POL-SVHC-UTILISEES.definition: Total weight of substances of very high concern used during production and during the delivery of services by the entity during the period, in tonnes (E2-5 §19(a), E2 AR 5, AR 6). A substance that falls in several hazard classes is counted once in this total (no double counting). Substances of very high concern: substances that meet the criteria of Article 57 of the REACH regulation and are identified under its Article 59(1) (candidate list). Only for an entity outside the scope of §18 that uses substances (E2 AR 4): enter 0 if there is none; any other entity answers N/A. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Chemical substances register, REACH registrations, material accounts of the entity.

POL-SVHC-TAB.name: Substances of very high concern by hazard class
POL-SVHC-TAB.unit: table: Hazard class (CLP), Procured, Manufactured, Placed on the market, Used, Released into the environment
POL-SVHC-TAB.definition: One row per hazard class of the CLP regulation: weight in tonnes of the substances of very high concern procured, manufactured, placed on the market, used and released into the environment during the period (E2-5 §18, §19, E2 AR 5). A substance is counted in each of its hazard classes: the rows must not be added up. The totals without double counting are entered in the total weight KPIs. Same scope as the totals (§18 or §19, E2 AR 4); any other entity answers N/A. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Chemical substances register, REACH registrations, material accounts of the entity.

POL-SVHC-ARTICLES-ACHETES.name: Substances of very high concern above 0.1 % in procured articles
POL-SVHC-ARTICLES-ACHETES.definition: Names of the substances of very high concern present at more than 0.1 % by weight in the procured components or articles (E2-5 §20(a), Article 33 of the REACH regulation, E2 AR 7). For a manufacturer, an importer or a user of articles that contain them. Answer N/A if no article contains any. The information may refer to what is already reported under another law. Phase-in: a company that only uses articles containing these substances may omit this information before 2028 (wave one) or for its first financial year of reporting (other companies) (ESRS 1 §125(e), §126(e), §127(e)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

POL-SVHC-ARTICLES-VENDUS.name: Substances of very high concern above 0.1 % in articles placed on the market
POL-SVHC-ARTICLES-VENDUS.definition: Names of the substances of very high concern present at more than 0.1 % by weight in the components or articles placed on the market (E2-5 §20(b), Article 33 of the REACH regulation, E2 AR 7). For a manufacturer, an importer or a user of articles that contain them. Answer N/A if no article contains any. The information may refer to what is already reported under another law. Phase-in: a company that only uses articles containing these substances may omit this information before 2028 (wave one) or for its first financial year of reporting (other companies) (ESRS 1 §125(e), §126(e), §127(e)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

EAU-POLITIQUES.name: Policies adopted on water
EAU-POLITIQUES.definition: Has the company adopted policies to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on water? If not, answer No: the standard asks to say so (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

EAU-POLIT-CONTENU.name: Policies on water: contents and changes
EAU-POLIT-CONTENU.definition: For each policy: its key contents, its general objectives and the material impacts, risks or opportunities it addresses; describe the changes made during the period (ESRS 2 §42(a)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

EAU-POLIT-PERIMETRE.name: Policies on water: scope and exclusions
EAU-POLIT-PERIMETRE.definition: For each policy: its scope or exclusions (own operations, upstream and downstream value chain, geographies and, if defined, the affected stakeholder groups) (ESRS 2 §42(b)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

EAU-POLIT-REFERENCES.name: Policies on water: third-party standards or initiatives
EAU-POLIT-REFERENCES.definition: Third-party standards or initiatives that the company commits to respect through its policies (ESRS 2 §42(c)). Answer N/A if no policy refers to one. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

EAU-ACTIONS.name: Key actions on water
EAU-ACTIONS.definition: Has the company taken or planned key actions to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on water? If not, answer No (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

EAU-ACT-DESC.name: Key actions on water: description, scope and expected outcomes
EAU-ACT-DESC.definition: Key actions taken during the period and planned, with their timeframe, their scope (own operations, value chain, subsidiaries, geographies, stakeholders) and their expected outcomes, and how they serve the policy objectives (ESRS 2 §45). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

EAU-ACT-TAB.name: Key actions on water: timeframe and financial resources
EAU-ACT-TAB.unit: table: Key action, Status, Timeframe, Scope, Capital expenditure of the period, Operating expenditure of the period, Future resources, low estimate, Future resources, high estimate, Depends on preconditions, Related to areas with water stress
EAU-ACT-TAB.definition: One row per key action: status, timeframe, scope, capital and operating expenditure of the period, range of future resources, and whether the action depends on preconditions (ESRS 2 §45-46). Amounts only when significant resources are allocated. Amounts in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Action plans, budget, accounting (capital and operating expenditure).

EAU-ACT-MOYENS.name: Key actions on water: type of resources, preconditions and line items
EAU-ACT-MOYENS.definition: When significant financial resources are allocated to the actions: their type (current and future), the preconditions the actions depend on (financial support, public policy, market) and the line items or notes of the financial statements that contain the amounts (ESRS 2 §46). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

EAU-CIBLES.name: Measurable targets on water
EAU-CIBLES.definition: Has the company set measurable, time-bound and outcome-oriented targets on water? If not, answer No and describe below how it tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

EAU-CIB-TAB.name: Targets on water: values, years and scope
EAU-CIB-TAB.unit: table: Target, Metric, Absolute or relative, Unit, Base year, Baseline value, Milestone year, Milestone value, Target year, Target value, Required by law, Based on conclusive scientific evidence, Scope
EAU-CIB-TAB.definition: One row per target: metric and unit, absolute or relative target, baseline value and year, milestone, target value and year, whether it is required by law, whether it is based on conclusive scientific evidence (environmental topics), scope (ESRS 2 §51). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Company strategy, roadmaps and dashboards.

EAU-CIB-DESC.name: Targets on water: link to policies, milestones, methods and scenarios
EAU-CIB-DESC.definition: For each target: its link to the policy objectives and actions, the milestones or interim targets, the methods and significant assumptions and, where applicable, the scenarios, the key data sources and the compatibility with national, EU or international policy goals (ESRS 2 §51(a), (e), (f), (h)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

EAU-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.name: Tracking of effectiveness without targets on water
EAU-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.definition: Only if no measurable target is set: whether and how the company still tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Answer N/A if targets are set. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

EAU-METHODES.name: Metrics on water: methods, sources, value chain data and context
EAU-METHODES.definition: For each metric: unit, calculation method and sources, estimation method with its significant assumptions and limitations; for a value chain metric, reliance on indirect sources or proxies and the planned improvements; contextual information (ESRS 2 §49(a) to (c)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

EAU-EVOLUTION.name: Metrics on water: significant changes and progress
EAU-EVOLUTION.definition: Significant changes in performance compared with the previous periods, progress towards the targets and effect of major acquisitions or disposals (ESRS 2 §49(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

EAU-STRESS-HORS-POLITIQUE.name: Sites in water-stress areas not covered by the water policies
EAU-STRESS-HORS-POLITIQUE.definition: Does the company have sites in areas with water stress that its water policies do not cover? If yes, the standard asks to say so (E3-1 §11). Areas with water stress: indicators of E3 AR 2, for example a baseline water stress of ‘High’ or more in the WRI Aqueduct tool. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Water policies, list of sites, WRI Aqueduct tool.

EAU-REJET.name: Total water discharge
EAU-REJET.definition: Effluents and other water leaving the site to surface water, groundwater or third parties during the period, in cubic metres (E3-4 §16(d)). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Meter readings, water bills, withdrawal and discharge permits.

EAU-CONSOMMATION.name: Total water consumption
EAU-CONSOMMATION.definition: Calculated by the tool: water withdrawn minus water discharged (E3-4 §16(a), E3 AR 4). It is the water that enters the site and does not leave it to the environment or to a third party. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

EAU-RECYCLEE.name: Total water recycled and reused
EAU-RECYCLEE.definition: Water and wastewater (treated or not) used more than once before it leaves the company: in the same process (recycled), in another process or another site of the company (reused), in cubic metres (E3-4 §16(e)). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Meters of the recycling loops, reports of the treatment plant.

EAU-STOCKEE.name: Total water stored
EAU-STOCKEE.definition: Water held in the storage facilities or reservoirs of the site at the end of the period, in cubic metres (E3-4 §16(f)). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Reservoir level readings, tank capacity.

EAU-CONSO-STRESS.name: Water consumption in areas with water stress (all discharges deducted)
EAU-CONSO-STRESS.definition: For a site located in an area with water stress (indicators of E3 AR 2, for example a baseline water stress of ‘High’ or more in the WRI Aqueduct tool): its water consumption of the period, water withdrawn minus all water discharged, like the total consumption (E3-4 §16(b), E3 AR 4), in cubic metres; a site outside areas with water stress enters 0. The Voluntary Standard VS has its own KPI, which deducts only the discharge of production processes (B6 §37). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Meter readings, water bills, WRI Aqueduct tool.

BIO-POLITIQUES.name: Policies adopted on biodiversity and ecosystems
BIO-POLITIQUES.definition: Has the company adopted policies to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on biodiversity and ecosystems? If not, answer No: the standard asks to say so (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-POLIT-CONTENU.name: Policies on biodiversity and ecosystems: contents and changes
BIO-POLIT-CONTENU.definition: For each policy: its key contents, its general objectives and the material impacts, risks or opportunities it addresses; describe the changes made during the period (ESRS 2 §42(a)). Say, where applicable, whether the policies address sustainable land or agricultural practices, sustainable oceans or seas practices, and deforestation (E4 AR 3). Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-POLIT-PERIMETRE.name: Policies on biodiversity and ecosystems: scope and exclusions
BIO-POLIT-PERIMETRE.definition: For each policy: its scope or exclusions (own operations, upstream and downstream value chain, geographies and, if defined, the affected stakeholder groups) (ESRS 2 §42(b)). Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-POLIT-REFERENCES.name: Policies on biodiversity and ecosystems: third-party standards or initiatives
BIO-POLIT-REFERENCES.definition: Third-party standards or initiatives that the company commits to respect through its policies (ESRS 2 §42(c)). Answer N/A if no policy refers to one. Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-ACTIONS.name: Key actions on biodiversity and ecosystems
BIO-ACTIONS.definition: Has the company taken or planned key actions to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on biodiversity and ecosystems? If not, answer No (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-ACT-DESC.name: Key actions on biodiversity and ecosystems: description, scope and expected outcomes
BIO-ACT-DESC.definition: Key actions taken during the period and planned, with their timeframe, their scope (own operations, value chain, subsidiaries, geographies, stakeholders) and their expected outcomes, and how they serve the policy objectives (ESRS 2 §45). The actions take into account the right of indigenous peoples to free, prior and informed consent (E4 AR 6). Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-ACT-TAB.name: Key actions on biodiversity and ecosystems: timeframe and financial resources
BIO-ACT-TAB.unit: table: Key action, Status, Timeframe, Scope, Capital expenditure of the period, Operating expenditure of the period, Future resources, low estimate, Future resources, high estimate, Depends on preconditions
BIO-ACT-TAB.definition: One row per key action: status, timeframe, scope, capital and operating expenditure of the period, range of future resources, and whether the action depends on preconditions (ESRS 2 §45-46). Amounts only when significant resources are allocated. Amounts in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)). Source: Action plans, budget, accounting (capital and operating expenditure).

BIO-ACT-MOYENS.name: Key actions on biodiversity and ecosystems: type of resources, preconditions and line items
BIO-ACT-MOYENS.definition: When significant financial resources are allocated to the actions: their type (current and future), the preconditions the actions depend on (financial support, public policy, market) and the line items or notes of the financial statements that contain the amounts (ESRS 2 §46). Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-CIBLES.name: Measurable targets on biodiversity and ecosystems
BIO-CIBLES.definition: Has the company set measurable, time-bound and outcome-oriented targets on biodiversity and ecosystems? If not, answer No and describe below how it tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-CIB-TAB.name: Targets on biodiversity and ecosystems: values, years and scope
BIO-CIB-TAB.unit: table: Target, Metric, Absolute or relative, Unit, Base year, Baseline value, Milestone year, Milestone value, Target year, Target value, Required by law, Based on conclusive scientific evidence, Scope
BIO-CIB-TAB.definition: One row per target: metric and unit, absolute or relative target, baseline value and year, milestone, target value and year, whether it is required by law, whether it is based on conclusive scientific evidence (environmental topics), scope (ESRS 2 §51). Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)). Source: Company strategy, roadmaps and dashboards.

BIO-CIB-DESC.name: Targets on biodiversity and ecosystems: link to policies, milestones, methods and scenarios
BIO-CIB-DESC.definition: For each target: its link to the policy objectives and actions, the milestones or interim targets, the methods and significant assumptions and, where applicable, the scenarios, the key data sources and the compatibility with national, EU or international policy goals (ESRS 2 §51(a), (e), (f), (h)). Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.name: Tracking of effectiveness without targets on biodiversity and ecosystems
BIO-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.definition: Only if no measurable target is set: whether and how the company still tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Answer N/A if targets are set. Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-METHODES.name: Metrics on biodiversity and ecosystems: methods, sources, value chain data and context
BIO-METHODES.definition: For each metric: unit, calculation method and sources, estimation method with its significant assumptions and limitations; for a value chain metric, reliance on indirect sources or proxies and the planned improvements; contextual information (ESRS 2 §49(a) to (c)). Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-EVOLUTION.name: Metrics on biodiversity and ecosystems: significant changes and progress
BIO-EVOLUTION.definition: Significant changes in performance compared with the previous periods, progress towards the targets and effect of major acquisitions or disposals (ESRS 2 §49(d)). Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-PLAN.name: Biodiversity transition plan in place and made public
BIO-PLAN.definition: Does the company have a transition plan that transforms its business model and strategy to contribute to halting and reversing biodiversity loss (Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework), and has it made the key features public? ‘Made public’: available before or at the release of the sustainability statement, for example on its website or in its reports. A climate plan that integrates biodiversity may do. If yes, describe the plan below (E4-1 §11, E4 AR 1, AR 2). Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-PLAN-TRANSITION.name: Key features of the biodiversity transition plan
BIO-PLAN-TRANSITION.definition: Only if the plan exists and is public: its key features (E4-1 §11). Such a plan usually contains targets, key actions, financial planning and governance, and explains how the strategy and business model will evolve; it can address synergies and trade-offs with other transition plan objectives (E4 AR 1). Answer N/A if there is no public plan. Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-POLIT-TRACABILITE.name: Biodiversity policies: traceability in the value chain
BIO-POLIT-TRACABILITE.definition: How the biodiversity and ecosystems policies support the traceability of the products, components and raw materials that have, or could have, material impacts on biodiversity in the value chain (E4-2 §13(a)). Answer N/A if there is no policy on this point. Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-POLIT-SITES.name: Biodiversity policies: sites in or near sensitive areas
BIO-POLIT-SITES.definition: What the biodiversity and ecosystems policies provide for the sites of the own operations in or near a biodiversity-sensitive area (E4-2 §13(b)). A site outside an area is ‘near’ it according to its area of influence, which the company defines for example with buffer distances specific to its type of activity (E4 AR 5). Answer N/A if no site is concerned. Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-COMPENSATIONS.name: Biodiversity offsets used
BIO-COMPENSATIONS.definition: The biodiversity offsets used in the actions: their aim, the financing effects in monetary terms, the area, type and quality criteria applied, and the standards they comply with (E4-3 §15). An offset is a measurable conservation outcome that compensates for unavoidable negative impacts, in addition to prevention and mitigation (glossary). Write the amounts and areas in the text. Answer N/A if there are none. Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-CIBLES-COMPENSATIONS.name: Use of biodiversity offsets in the targets
BIO-CIBLES-COMPENSATIONS.definition: Only if the company uses biodiversity offsets in setting its targets: how it used them (E4-4 §17). Answer N/A otherwise. Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-LIEUX-DESC.name: Locations of the own operations linked to material biodiversity matters
BIO-LIEUX-DESC.definition: The locations of the own operations to which the material biodiversity and ecosystems impacts, risks or opportunities relate, when they are not sites of the organisation tree (E4-5 §19(a), E4 AR 8). Each site of the tree answers with the yes / no ‘site concerned’. No exhaustive list is needed: the company may group the sites that affect the same sensitive area or have similar impacts, risks or opportunities, as long as this does not hide material information. Answer N/A if all the locations are sites of the tree. Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-SITE-IRO.name: Site linked to a material biodiversity impact, risk or opportunity
BIO-SITE-IRO.definition: Is the site a location to which material biodiversity and ecosystems impacts, risks or opportunities relate (E4-5 §19(a), E4 AR 8)? If yes, fill in the next two texts. Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-SITE-ZONE-IMPACT.name: Sensitive areas affected by the site (name and type)
BIO-SITE-ZONE-IMPACT.definition: For a site concerned: the list of the biodiversity-sensitive areas related to its material negative impacts, with the name and type of each area (E4-5 §19(b)). Sensitive areas: protected areas (Natura 2000, UNESCO natural world heritage sites, Ramsar sites…), Key Biodiversity Areas, ecologically or biologically significant marine areas, habitats of species of the IUCN Red List (glossary). Answer N/A if the site is not concerned or has no material negative impact on a sensitive area. Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)). Source: Impact assessment, operating permits, maps of protected areas, site operating records.

BIO-SITE-ACTIVITES.name: Activities of the site linked to negative impacts on sensitive areas
BIO-SITE-ACTIVITES.definition: For a site that has a material negative impact on a sensitive area: the activities of the site that are linked to this impact (E4-5 §19(c)). Answer N/A otherwise. Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)). Source: Impact assessment, operating permits, maps of protected areas, site operating records.

BIO-INDICATEURS.name: Metrics on the material impacts on biodiversity
BIO-INDICATEURS.definition: One row per company metric on its material impacts on biodiversity and ecosystems: name, value, unit, scope (E4-5 §20). The standard defines no metric. Depending on the material sub-topic, they cover drivers of change, the state of species, the condition and extent of ecosystems or ecosystem services (E4 AR 10). Primary data from the field or remote sensing is best; otherwise estimates from pressure data (E4 AR 11). Say in the methods text the monitoring frequency, the baseline condition and the baseline year (E4 AR 12). Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)). Source: Ecological monitoring, field surveys, satellite imagery, impact assessments.

BIO-IMPACT-SOLS.name: Material impacts related to land degradation, desertification or soil sealing
BIO-IMPACT-SOLS.definition: Among the material impacts described in the assessment of impacts, risks and opportunities, do any concern land degradation, desertification or soil sealing (E4 AR 9, for E4-5 §20)? If yes, the text on the material impacts (ESRS 2 IRO-2) says so. Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

BIO-IMPACT-ESPECES.name: Operations that affect threatened species or ecosystems
BIO-IMPACT-ESPECES.definition: Among the material impacts, do any concern operations that affect threatened species or ecosystems (E4 AR 9, for E4-5 §20)? Threatened species: endangered species of the European Red List or the IUCN Red List of Threatened Species; threatened ecosystems: ecosystems classed as critically endangered, endangered or vulnerable in the IUCN Red List of Ecosystems (glossary). If yes, the text on the material impacts (ESRS 2 IRO-2) says so. Phase-in: a wave-one company may omit the whole of ESRS E4 for financial years starting before 2027, and any other company for its first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a), §127(a)).

ECO-CIRC-POLITIQUES.name: Policies adopted on resource use and circular economy
ECO-CIRC-POLITIQUES.definition: Has the company adopted policies to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on resource use and circular economy? If not, answer No: the standard asks to say so (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

ECO-CIRC-POLIT-CONTENU.name: Policies on resource use and circular economy: contents and changes
ECO-CIRC-POLIT-CONTENU.definition: For each policy: its key contents, its general objectives and the material impacts, risks or opportunities it addresses; describe the changes made during the period (ESRS 2 §42(a)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

ECO-CIRC-POLIT-PERIMETRE.name: Policies on resource use and circular economy: scope and exclusions
ECO-CIRC-POLIT-PERIMETRE.definition: For each policy: its scope or exclusions (own operations, upstream and downstream value chain, geographies and, if defined, the affected stakeholder groups) (ESRS 2 §42(b)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

ECO-CIRC-POLIT-REFERENCES.name: Policies on resource use and circular economy: third-party standards or initiatives
ECO-CIRC-POLIT-REFERENCES.definition: Third-party standards or initiatives that the company commits to respect through its policies (ESRS 2 §42(c)). Answer N/A if no policy refers to one. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

ECO-CIRC-ACTIONS.name: Key actions on resource use and circular economy
ECO-CIRC-ACTIONS.definition: Has the company taken or planned key actions to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on resource use and circular economy? If not, answer No (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

ECO-CIRC-ACT-DESC.name: Key actions on resource use and circular economy: description, scope and expected outcomes
ECO-CIRC-ACT-DESC.definition: Key actions taken during the period and planned, with their timeframe, their scope (own operations, value chain, subsidiaries, geographies, stakeholders) and their expected outcomes, and how they serve the policy objectives (ESRS 2 §45). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

ECO-CIRC-ACT-TAB.name: Key actions on resource use and circular economy: timeframe and financial resources
ECO-CIRC-ACT-TAB.unit: table: Key action, Status, Timeframe, Scope, Capital expenditure of the period, Operating expenditure of the period, Future resources, low estimate, Future resources, high estimate, Depends on preconditions
ECO-CIRC-ACT-TAB.definition: One row per key action: status, timeframe, scope, capital and operating expenditure of the period, range of future resources, and whether the action depends on preconditions (ESRS 2 §45-46). Amounts only when significant resources are allocated. Amounts in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Action plans, budget, accounting (capital and operating expenditure).

ECO-CIRC-ACT-MOYENS.name: Key actions on resource use and circular economy: type of resources, preconditions and line items
ECO-CIRC-ACT-MOYENS.definition: When significant financial resources are allocated to the actions: their type (current and future), the preconditions the actions depend on (financial support, public policy, market) and the line items or notes of the financial statements that contain the amounts (ESRS 2 §46). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

ECO-CIRC-CIBLES.name: Measurable targets on resource use and circular economy
ECO-CIRC-CIBLES.definition: Has the company set measurable, time-bound and outcome-oriented targets on resource use and circular economy? If not, answer No and describe below how it tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

ECO-CIRC-CIB-TAB.name: Targets on resource use and circular economy: values, years and scope
ECO-CIRC-CIB-TAB.unit: table: Target, Metric, Absolute or relative, Unit, Base year, Baseline value, Milestone year, Milestone value, Target year, Target value, Required by law, Based on conclusive scientific evidence, Scope
ECO-CIRC-CIB-TAB.definition: One row per target: metric and unit, absolute or relative target, baseline value and year, milestone, target value and year, whether it is required by law, whether it is based on conclusive scientific evidence (environmental topics), scope (ESRS 2 §51). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Company strategy, roadmaps and dashboards.

ECO-CIRC-CIB-DESC.name: Targets on resource use and circular economy: link to policies, milestones, methods and scenarios
ECO-CIRC-CIB-DESC.definition: For each target: its link to the policy objectives and actions, the milestones or interim targets, the methods and significant assumptions and, where applicable, the scenarios, the key data sources and the compatibility with national, EU or international policy goals (ESRS 2 §51(a), (e), (f), (h)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

ECO-CIRC-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.name: Tracking of effectiveness without targets on resource use and circular economy
ECO-CIRC-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.definition: Only if no measurable target is set: whether and how the company still tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Answer N/A if targets are set. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

ECO-CIRC-METHODES.name: Metrics on resource use and circular economy: methods, sources, value chain data and context
ECO-CIRC-METHODES.definition: For each metric: unit, calculation method and sources, estimation method with its significant assumptions and limitations; for a value chain metric, reliance on indirect sources or proxies and the planned improvements; contextual information (ESRS 2 §49(a) to (c)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

ECO-CIRC-EVOLUTION.name: Metrics on resource use and circular economy: significant changes and progress
ECO-CIRC-EVOLUTION.definition: Significant changes in performance compared with the previous periods, progress towards the targets and effect of major acquisitions or disposals (ESRS 2 §49(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

ECO-CIRC-ECOCONCEPTION.name: Circular economy principles and eco-design in key products and services
ECO-CIRC-ECOCONCEPTION.definition: Only if the company integrates circular economy principles or eco-design requirements in its key products and circular economy services: explain how (E5-1 §9). Circular economy principles: eliminate waste and pollution by design, circulate products and materials at their highest value through maintenance, reuse and refurbishment, regenerate nature (glossary). Key product: a product central to value creation or strategy, defined by managerial assessment (glossary). Answer N/A otherwise. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

ECO-CIRC-MATIERES-DESC.name: Key materials, critical and strategic raw materials
ECO-CIRC-MATIERES-DESC.definition: A short description of each key material used, with its role and relevance in the operations, and the critical or strategic raw materials it contains (E5-4 §13(a), E5 AR 1, AR 2). Key material: a material, substance, component or product essential to the ability to manufacture or deliver, identified by managerial assessment (volume, cost, criticality, external factors) (glossary). Tell technical material from biological material if it helps to understand the impacts, risks or opportunities; point out the critical and strategic raw materials of Regulation (EU) 2024/1252 (Annexes I and II), for example a battery that contains lithium. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

ECO-CIRC-MATIERES-POIDS.name: Total weight of key materials
ECO-CIRC-MATIERES-POIDS.definition: Weight of all the key materials that entered the operations of the site during the period, in tonnes (E5-4 §13(b)). Also the total for the share of secondary resources. Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Purchasing, bills of materials, material balances.

ECO-CIRC-MATIERES-TAB.name: Weight of each key material
ECO-CIRC-MATIERES-TAB.definition: One row per key material: its weight in tonnes over the period (E5-4 §13(c)). The standard allows the weight or the share of the total weight: enter the weight, the share follows from the total weight of key materials. The total of the table must be the total weight of key materials. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Purchasing, bills of materials, material balances.

ECO-CIRC-SECONDAIRES.name: Weight of secondary resources used
ECO-CIRC-SECONDAIRES.definition: Weight of the secondary resources that entered the operations of the site during the period, in tonnes, among the key materials (E5-4 §13(d)). Secondary resource: a material previously used, recovered from waste streams or other sources, and reintroduced into production cycles, for example recycled material, reused, repaired, refurbished or remanufactured product or component (glossary). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Purchasing, recycled-content sheets, material balances.

ECO-CIRC-PART-SECONDAIRES.name: Share of secondary resources in key materials
ECO-CIRC-PART-SECONDAIRES.definition: Calculated by the tool: weight of secondary resources divided by the total weight of key materials (E5-4 §13(d), presentation as a share). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

ECO-CIRC-DURABILITE.name: Expected durability of key products
ECO-CIRC-DURABILITE.definition: For each key product: its expected durability, as qualitative or quantitative information (E5-5 §15(a)). If quantitative, write the measure and its unit, for example a lifetime in years or cycles, and how it is established. Key product: see the glossary. Answer N/A if there is no key product. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

ECO-CIRC-REPARABILITE.name: Repairability of key products
ECO-CIRC-REPARABILITE.definition: For each key product: the extent to which it is repairable, as qualitative or quantitative information (E5-5 §15(b)). If quantitative, write the measure and its unit, for example a repairability index, and how it is established. Answer N/A if there is no key product. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

ECO-CIRC-RECYCLABILITE.name: Designed recyclability rate of key products and their packaging
ECO-CIRC-RECYCLABILITE.unit: table: Key product, Designed recyclability rate of the product (%), Designed recyclability rate of the packaging (%)
ECO-CIRC-RECYCLABILITE.definition: One row per key product: the recyclability rate designed into the product and that of its packaging, as a percentage from 0 to 100 (E5-5 §15(c), E5 AR 3). Rate of a product = total weight of recyclable materials incorporated in the product ÷ total weight of the product × 100; same calculation for the packaging, with the weight of the packaging. Answer N/A if there is no key product. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Product sheets, bills of materials, recyclability studies.

DEC-FLUX-DESC.name: Waste streams
DEC-FLUX-DESC.definition: A description of the waste streams of the own operations: for each stream, a name (for example from the European List of Waste, Decision 2000/532/EC) and the key materials it contains (biomass, metals, non-metallic minerals, plastics, textiles, critical raw materials, rare earths…) (E5-5 §16(a), E5 AR 4). Also write what the ‘other recovery operations’ used are (E5 AR 6). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

DEC-AUTRE-VALO.name: Waste sent to other recovery operations
DEC-AUTRE-VALO.definition: Waste of the site sent to recovery operations other than preparation for reuse and recycling, during the period, in tonnes (E5-5 §16(c)(iii), E5 AR 6).
