Recovery operations: Annex II to Directive 2008/98/EC on waste. Incineration with energy recovery is one only if it meets condition R1 of that Annex; otherwise it is incineration (disposal). Say which ones in the description of the waste streams. Weight of the waste in its original state, with no further manipulation such as a dry weight (E5 AR 5). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Waste register, waste transfer notes, service provider reports.

DEC-DETOURNES.name: Waste diverted from disposal (reuse, recycling, other recovery)
DEC-DETOURNES.definition: Calculated by the tool: waste prepared for reuse, recycled and sent to other recovery operations (E5-5 §16(c)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

DEC-DETOURNES-DANG.name: Hazardous waste diverted from disposal
DEC-DETOURNES-DANG.definition: Part of the waste diverted from disposal (reuse, recycling, other recovery) that is hazardous, during the period, in tonnes (E5-5 §16(c)). Hazardous waste: it displays one or more of the hazardous properties of Annex III to Directive 2008/98/EC (glossary). Weight of the waste in its original state, with no further manipulation such as a dry weight (E5 AR 5). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Waste register, waste transfer notes, service provider reports.

DEC-INCINERATION.name: Waste incinerated (disposal)
DEC-INCINERATION.definition: Waste of the site sent to incineration that is not a recovery operation, during the period, in tonnes (E5-5 §16(d)(i)). Incineration with energy recovery that meets condition R1 of Annex II to Directive 2008/98/EC is counted in other recovery operations (E5 AR 6). Weight of the waste in its original state, with no further manipulation such as a dry weight (E5 AR 5). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Waste register, waste transfer notes, service provider reports.

DEC-DECHARGE.name: Waste sent to landfill
DEC-DECHARGE.definition: Waste of the site sent to landfill (a waste disposal site for deposit onto or into land) during the period, in tonnes (E5-5 §16(d)(ii)). Weight of the waste in its original state, with no further manipulation such as a dry weight (E5 AR 5). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Waste register, waste transfer notes, service provider reports.

DEC-AUTRE-ELIM.name: Waste sent to other disposal operations
DEC-AUTRE-ELIM.definition: Waste of the site disposed of otherwise than by incineration or landfill, during the period, in tonnes (E5-5 §16(d)(iii), E5 AR 7). Disposal operations: Annex I to Directive 2008/98/EC on waste. Weight of the waste in its original state, with no further manipulation such as a dry weight (E5 AR 5). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Waste register, waste transfer notes, service provider reports.

DEC-ELIMINES.name: Waste directed to disposal
DEC-ELIMINES.definition: Calculated by the tool: waste incinerated (disposal), sent to landfill and sent to other disposal operations (E5-5 §16(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

DEC-ELIMINES-DANG.name: Hazardous waste directed to disposal
DEC-ELIMINES-DANG.definition: Part of the waste directed to disposal (incineration, landfill, other disposal) that is hazardous, during the period, in tonnes (E5-5 §16(d)). Hazardous waste: it displays one or more of the hazardous properties of Annex III to Directive 2008/98/EC (glossary). Weight of the waste in its original state, with no further manipulation such as a dry weight (E5 AR 5). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Waste register, waste transfer notes, service provider reports.

DEC-INCONNUE.name: Waste with unknown final destination
DEC-INCONNUE.definition: Waste of the site whose final destination is not known, during the period, in tonnes (E5-5 §16(e)). Weight of the waste in its original state, with no further manipulation such as a dry weight (E5 AR 5). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Waste register, waste transfer notes, service provider reports.

DEC-RADIOACTIFS.name: Radioactive waste generated
DEC-RADIOACTIFS.definition: Total weight of the radioactive waste generated by the site during the period, in tonnes (E5-5 §17). Radioactive waste: as defined in Article 3(7) of Directive 2011/70/Euratom. Weight of the waste in its original state, with no further manipulation such as a dry weight (E5 AR 5). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Radioactive waste register, declarations to the competent authority.

DEC-PART-DETOURNES.name: Share of waste diverted from disposal (reuse, recycling, other recovery)
DEC-PART-DETOURNES.definition: Calculated by the tool: waste diverted from disposal divided by the total waste generated (E5-5 §16(c)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

DEC-PART-DET-DANG.name: Share of waste diverted from disposal: hazardous
DEC-PART-DET-DANG.definition: Calculated by the tool: hazardous waste diverted from disposal divided by the total waste generated (E5-5 §16(c)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

DEC-PART-DET-NON-DANG.name: Share of waste diverted from disposal: non-hazardous
DEC-PART-DET-NON-DANG.definition: Calculated by the tool: non-hazardous waste diverted from disposal (diverted minus hazardous diverted) divided by the total waste generated (E5-5 §16(c)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

DEC-PART-REEMPLOI.name: Share of waste prepared for reuse
DEC-PART-REEMPLOI.definition: Calculated by the tool: waste prepared for reuse divided by the total waste generated (E5-5 §16(c)(i)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

DEC-PART-RECYCLAGE.name: Share of waste recycled
DEC-PART-RECYCLAGE.definition: Calculated by the tool: waste recycled divided by the total waste generated (E5-5 §16(c)(ii)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

DEC-PART-AUTRE-VALO.name: Share of waste sent to other recovery operations
DEC-PART-AUTRE-VALO.definition: Calculated by the tool: waste sent to other recovery operations divided by the total waste generated (E5-5 §16(c)(iii)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

DEC-PART-ELIMINES.name: Share of waste directed to disposal
DEC-PART-ELIMINES.definition: Calculated by the tool: waste directed to disposal divided by the total waste generated (E5-5 §16(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

DEC-PART-ELIM-DANG.name: Share of waste directed to disposal: hazardous
DEC-PART-ELIM-DANG.definition: Calculated by the tool: hazardous waste directed to disposal divided by the total waste generated (E5-5 §16(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

DEC-PART-ELIM-NON-DANG.name: Share of waste directed to disposal: non-hazardous
DEC-PART-ELIM-NON-DANG.definition: Calculated by the tool: non-hazardous waste directed to disposal (disposal minus hazardous disposal) divided by the total waste generated (E5-5 §16(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

DEC-PART-INCINERATION.name: Share of waste incinerated (disposal)
DEC-PART-INCINERATION.definition: Calculated by the tool: waste incinerated (disposal) divided by the total waste generated (E5-5 §16(d)(i)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

DEC-PART-DECHARGE.name: Share of waste sent to landfill
DEC-PART-DECHARGE.definition: Calculated by the tool: waste sent to landfill divided by the total waste generated (E5-5 §16(d)(ii)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

DEC-PART-AUTRE-ELIM.name: Share of waste sent to other disposal operations
DEC-PART-AUTRE-ELIM.definition: Calculated by the tool: waste sent to other disposal operations divided by the total waste generated (E5-5 §16(d)(iii)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

DEC-PART-INCONNUE.name: Share of waste with unknown final destination
DEC-PART-INCONNUE.definition: Calculated by the tool: waste with unknown final destination divided by the total waste generated (E5-5 §16(e)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-POLITIQUES.name: Policies adopted on the own workforce
SOC-PERSO-POLITIQUES.definition: Has the company adopted policies to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on the own workforce? If not, answer No: the standard asks to say so (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-POLIT-CONTENU.name: Policies on the own workforce: contents and changes
SOC-PERSO-POLIT-CONTENU.definition: For each policy: its key contents, its general objectives and the material impacts, risks or opportunities it addresses; describe the changes made during the period (ESRS 2 §42(a)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-POLIT-PERIMETRE.name: Policies on the own workforce: scope and exclusions
SOC-PERSO-POLIT-PERIMETRE.definition: For each policy: its scope or exclusions (own operations, upstream and downstream value chain, geographies and, if defined, the affected stakeholder groups) (ESRS 2 §42(b)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-POLIT-REFERENCES.name: Policies on the own workforce: third-party standards or initiatives
SOC-PERSO-POLIT-REFERENCES.definition: Third-party standards or initiatives that the company commits to respect through its policies (ESRS 2 §42(c)). Answer N/A if no policy refers to one. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-POLIT-PARTIES.name: Policies on the own workforce: interests of affected stakeholders
SOC-PERSO-POLIT-PARTIES.definition: How the interests of affected stakeholders were considered in setting each policy, if they were (ESRS 2 §42(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-ACTIONS.name: Key actions on the own workforce
SOC-PERSO-ACTIONS.definition: Has the company taken or planned key actions to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on the own workforce? If not, answer No (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-ACT-DESC.name: Key actions on the own workforce: description, scope and expected outcomes
SOC-PERSO-ACT-DESC.definition: Key actions taken during the period and planned, with their timeframe, their scope (own operations, value chain, subsidiaries, geographies, stakeholders) and their expected outcomes, and how they serve the policy objectives (ESRS 2 §45). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-ACT-TAB.name: Key actions on the own workforce: timeframe and financial resources
SOC-PERSO-ACT-TAB.unit: table: Key action, Status, Timeframe, Scope, Capital expenditure of the period, Operating expenditure of the period, Future resources, low estimate, Future resources, high estimate, Depends on preconditions
SOC-PERSO-ACT-TAB.definition: One row per key action: status, timeframe, scope, capital and operating expenditure of the period, range of future resources, and whether the action depends on preconditions (ESRS 2 §45-46). Amounts only when significant resources are allocated. Amounts in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Action plans, budget, accounting (capital and operating expenditure).

SOC-PERSO-ACT-MOYENS.name: Key actions on the own workforce: type of resources, preconditions and line items
SOC-PERSO-ACT-MOYENS.definition: When significant financial resources are allocated to the actions: their type (current and future), the preconditions the actions depend on (financial support, public policy, market) and the line items or notes of the financial statements that contain the amounts (ESRS 2 §46). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-CIBLES.name: Measurable targets on the own workforce
SOC-PERSO-CIBLES.definition: Has the company set measurable, time-bound and outcome-oriented targets on the own workforce? If not, answer No and describe below how it tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-CIB-TAB.name: Targets on the own workforce: values, years and scope
SOC-PERSO-CIB-TAB.unit: table: Target, Metric, Absolute or relative, Unit, Base year, Baseline value, Milestone year, Milestone value, Target year, Target value, Required by law, Based on conclusive scientific evidence, Scope
SOC-PERSO-CIB-TAB.definition: One row per target: metric and unit, absolute or relative target, baseline value and year, milestone, target value and year, whether it is required by law, whether it is based on conclusive scientific evidence (environmental topics), scope (ESRS 2 §51). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Company strategy, roadmaps and dashboards.

SOC-PERSO-CIB-DESC.name: Targets on the own workforce: link to policies, milestones, methods and scenarios
SOC-PERSO-CIB-DESC.definition: For each target: its link to the policy objectives and actions, the milestones or interim targets, the methods and significant assumptions and, where applicable, the scenarios, the key data sources and the compatibility with national, EU or international policy goals (ESRS 2 §51(a), (e), (f), (h)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.name: Tracking of effectiveness without targets on the own workforce
SOC-PERSO-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.definition: Only if no measurable target is set: whether and how the company still tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Answer N/A if targets are set. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-METHODES.name: Metrics on the own workforce: methods, sources, value chain data and context
SOC-PERSO-METHODES.definition: For each metric: unit, calculation method and sources, estimation method with its significant assumptions and limitations; for a value chain metric, reliance on indirect sources or proxies and the planned improvements; contextual information (ESRS 2 §49(a) to (c)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-EVOLUTION.name: Metrics on the own workforce: significant changes and progress
SOC-PERSO-EVOLUTION.definition: Significant changes in performance compared with the previous periods, progress towards the targets and effect of major acquisitions or disposals (ESRS 2 §49(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-POLIT-COUVERTURE.name: Own workforce policies: whole workforce or specific groups
SOC-PERSO-POLIT-COUVERTURE.definition: For each policy: say whether it covers all the own workforce or only specific groups (for example the employees of one plant or one country, or self-employed people) (ESRS S1, §10). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-DIALOGUE.name: Engagement with the own workforce and its representatives
SOC-PERSO-DIALOGUE.definition: How the company engages directly with its own workforce or with workers' representatives (information sessions, consultation, participation, frequency), and how the views of the workforce inform its decisions and activities to manage the impacts on it during the year (ESRS S1, §13, AR 2). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-VULNERABLES.name: Views of vulnerable or marginalised workers
SOC-PERSO-VULNERABLES.definition: If the company takes action to understand them: how it gains insight into the views of the people in its own workforce who are particularly vulnerable to impacts or marginalised (for example women, migrants, persons with disabilities) (ESRS S1, §13(a)). Answer N/A if it does not. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-ACCORDS-CADRES.name: Global framework agreements on the human rights of the own workforce
SOC-PERSO-ACCORDS-CADRES.definition: Global framework agreements or other outcomes reached with workers' representatives on the respect of the human rights of the own workforce (ESRS S1, §13(b)). Answer N/A if there is none. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-CANAUX.name: Channels for the own workforce to raise concerns, and their effectiveness
SOC-PERSO-CANAUX.definition: Channels available to the own workforce to bring its concerns or needs directly to the company's attention and have them addressed, and how the company assesses their effectiveness (for example with the criteria of Principle 31 of the UN Guiding Principles) (ESRS S1, §14, AR 3). Whether a grievance mechanism exists is answered separately. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-REPARATION.name: Approach to remedy for the own workforce
SOC-PERSO-REPARATION.definition: General approach and processes of the company to provide or cooperate in remedy when it has caused or contributed to a material negative impact on people in its own workforce (ESRS S1, §15). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-ACTIONS-IMPACTS.name: Actions on material negative impacts on the own workforce
SOC-PERSO-ACTIONS-IMPACTS.definition: Key actions taken, planned or under way to prevent, mitigate, bring to an end, minimise and remediate material negative impacts on the own workforce, including when these actions are in tension with other business pressures; measures linked to the climate transition (for example internal redeployment when a plant closes) (ESRS S1, §17(a), AR 4, AR 5). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PERSO-ACTIONS-SUIVI.name: Tracking of the effectiveness of the actions for the own workforce
SOC-PERSO-ACTIONS-SUIVI.definition: How the company tracks and assesses the effectiveness of these actions in delivering outcomes for its own workforce (ESRS S1, §17(b)). If this tracking is already described with the targets or the metrics (ESRS 2 GDR-T, GDR-M), a reference is enough. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-EFF-CDI-F.name: Permanent female employees at end of period
SOC-EFF-CDI-F.definition: Female employees on a permanent contract (definition of the law of the country where they work) at the end of the period, as a headcount (ESRS S1, §20(c)(i), AR 7, AR 10). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: HR information system, payroll.

SOC-EFF-CDI-H.name: Permanent male employees at end of period
SOC-EFF-CDI-H.definition: Male employees on a permanent contract (definition of the law of the country where they work) at the end of the period, as a headcount (ESRS S1, §20(c)(i), AR 7, AR 10). Other genders are the rest of the permanent total. Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: HR information system, payroll.

SOC-EFF-TEMPORAIRES.name: Temporary employees at end of period
SOC-EFF-TEMPORAIRES.definition: Employees on a temporary (fixed-term) contract (definition of the law of the country where they work) at the end of the period, as a headcount, all genders (ESRS S1, §20(c)(ii), AR 7, AR 10). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: HR information system, payroll.

SOC-EFF-TEMP-F.name: Temporary female employees at end of period
SOC-EFF-TEMP-F.definition: Female employees on a temporary contract at the end of the period, as a headcount (ESRS S1, §20(c)(ii)). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: HR information system, payroll.

SOC-EFF-TEMP-H.name: Temporary male employees at end of period
SOC-EFF-TEMP-H.definition: Male employees on a temporary contract at the end of the period, as a headcount (ESRS S1, §20(c)(ii)). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: HR information system, payroll.

SOC-EFF-HEURES-NON-GARANTIES.name: Non-guaranteed hours employees at end of period
SOC-EFF-HEURES-NON-GARANTIES.definition: Employees without a guaranteed minimum or fixed number of working hours (zero-hour contracts, on-call and casual employees) at the end of the period, as a headcount; depending on national law, they are also counted as permanent or temporary (ESRS S1, §20(c)(iii), AR 10). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: HR information system, payroll.

SOC-EFF-MOYEN.name: Average employee headcount
SOC-EFF-MOYEN.definition: Average number of employees over the period, all contracts (for example the average of the month-end headcounts), as a headcount: denominator of the turnover rate (ESRS S1, §20(d), AR 11). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: HR information system, payroll.

SOC-ROTATION-CDI.name: Turnover rate of permanent employees
SOC-ROTATION-CDI.definition: Calculated by the tool: leavers on permanent contracts (resignation, dismissal, retirement, death in service) divided by the average headcount of all employees, as AR 11 requires (ESRS S1, §20(d), AR 11). Recalculated at each level from the totals. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-EFF-ECART-COMPTES.name: Difference between the reported headcount and the financial statements
SOC-EFF-ECART-COMPTES.definition: Only if the total headcount reported does not match the most representative number in the financial statements (for example an average or full-time equivalent figure): explanation of the difference (ESRS S1, §20(e)). Answer N/A otherwise. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-NON-SALARIES.name: Non-employees in the own workforce at end of period
SOC-NON-SALARIES.definition: People in the company's own workforce who are not its employees, at the end of the period, as a headcount: self-employed people who supply labour to the company under contract, and people provided by employment agencies (NACE N78) (ESRS S1, §7, §22, AR 13). All self-employed people who supply labour are counted, not only those who work exclusively for the company. S1-6 is disclosed only if non-employees are connected to material impacts, risks or opportunities (ESRS S1, §1(b), AR 12); the number is also used for the share of the own workforce covered by health and safety (§37(a)): enter it as soon as it is known. An N/A answer (phase-in, non-employees not tracked) makes this share and the accident rate of the own workforce cover employees only. Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125(f) to §127(f)): may be omitted for financial years before 2027 (wave-one undertakings) or for the first year of reporting (other undertakings). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Contracts of self-employed people, statements and invoices of employment agencies.

SOC-PART-CONVENTION.name: Share of employees covered by collective bargaining agreements
SOC-PART-CONVENTION.definition: Calculated by the tool: employees covered by collective bargaining agreements divided by the total headcount (ESRS S1, §24(a), AR 14). Read by country (countries of the European Economic Area with significant employment, §24(b)) or by region outside the Area (§24(c)) in the views by organisation. Every site enters the number of its covered employees, outside the EEA too during the phase-in: an N/A answer would take its covered employees out of the calculation but not its headcount, and the share would be wrong; the EEA share is then read on the EEA organisations. Phase-in for employees outside the European Economic Area (ESRS 1 §125(f) to §127(f)): they may be left out for financial years before 2027 (wave-one undertakings) or for the first year of reporting (other undertakings). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-CONVENTION-EEE.name: Collective bargaining agreements in the European Economic Area
SOC-CONVENTION-EEE.definition: Does the company have one or more collective bargaining agreements in the European Economic Area? If yes, the share of employees covered by country is read in the views by organisation (ESRS S1, §24(b)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-SAL-REPRESENTES.name: Employees in establishments with workers' representatives
SOC-SAL-REPRESENTES.definition: Employees who work, at the end of the period, in an establishment (plant, branch, headquarters…) where the employees are represented by workers' representatives (trade union or elected), as a headcount (ESRS S1, §25(a), AR 16). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: HR information system, payroll.

SOC-PART-REPRESENTES.name: Share of employees covered by workers' representatives
SOC-PART-REPRESENTES.definition: Calculated by the tool: employees in establishments with workers' representatives divided by the total headcount (ESRS S1, §25(a), AR 16). The standard asks for it for each country of the European Economic Area with significant employment: read it by country in the views by organisation. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-COMITE-EUROPEEN.name: Agreement for a European works council
SOC-COMITE-EUROPEEN.definition: Is there an agreement with the employees for their representation by a European Works Council, a Societas Europaea (SE) or a Societas Cooperativa Europaea (SCE) works council (ESRS S1, §25(b))? Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-DIRECTION-F.name: Women in top management
SOC-DIRECTION-F.definition: Women in top management at the end of the period, as a headcount. Top management: the two levels below the administrative and supervisory bodies, or the company's own definition, to be given in the methods text (ESRS S1, §27, AR 17). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: HR information system, payroll.

SOC-DIRECTION-H.name: Men in top management
SOC-DIRECTION-H.definition: Men in top management at the end of the period, as a headcount, with the same definition as for women (ESRS S1, §27, AR 17). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: HR information system, payroll.

SOC-DIRECTION-AUTRE.name: Top management members of another gender or with gender not reported
SOC-DIRECTION-AUTRE.definition: Top management members of another gender or whose gender is not reported, at the end of the period, as a headcount (ESRS S1, §27): they count in the total used for the shares. Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: HR information system, payroll.

SOC-DIRECTION-PART-F.name: Share of women in top management
SOC-DIRECTION-PART-F.definition: Calculated by the tool: women in top management divided by all its members (ESRS S1, §27). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-DIRECTION-PART-H.name: Share of men in top management
SOC-DIRECTION-PART-H.definition: Calculated by the tool: men in top management divided by all its members (ESRS S1, §27). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-SALAIRE-DECENT.name: All employees are paid an adequate wage
SOC-SALAIRE-DECENT.definition: Are all employees paid an adequate wage? Compare, country by country, the lowest wage (interns and apprentices excluded: basic wage plus fixed payments guaranteed to all) with a benchmark that cannot be lower, in the EU, than the wage set by collective bargaining or the statutory minimum wage (Directive (EU) 2022/2041) and, outside the EU, than the adequate minimum wage or a living wage estimate (ILO principles) (ESRS S1, §29, AR 18 to AR 20). An adequate wage is not necessarily the minimum wage. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-SALAIRE-DECENT-REF.name: Adequate wage benchmarks and their countries
SOC-SALAIRE-DECENT-REF.definition: Benchmark or benchmarks used to decide whether a wage is adequate, with the countries for which each one is used (ESRS S1, §29, AR 20). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Collective agreements, statutory minimum wages, living wage estimates.

SOC-SAL-SOUS-DECENT.name: Employees not paid an adequate wage
SOC-SAL-SOUS-DECENT.definition: Employees whose wage is below the adequate wage benchmark of their country, at the end of the period, as a headcount (ESRS S1, §29, AR 19). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Payroll.

SOC-PART-SOUS-DECENT.name: Share of employees not paid an adequate wage
SOC-PART-SOUS-DECENT.definition: Calculated by the tool: employees below the adequate wage benchmark divided by the total headcount (ESRS S1, §29). The standard asks for it for each country concerned: read it by country in the views by organisation. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PROTECTION-MALADIE.name: Countries without social protection: sickness
SOC-PROTECTION-MALADIE.definition: Only if employees lack social protection, through public programmes or benefits offered by the company: countries where loss of income due to sickness is not covered by the existing social protection (ESRS S1, §31(a)). Answer ‘None’ if all employees are covered. Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125(f) to §127(f)): may be omitted for financial years before 2027 (wave-one undertakings) or for the first year of reporting (other undertakings). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PROTECTION-CHOMAGE.name: Countries without social protection: unemployment
SOC-PROTECTION-CHOMAGE.definition: Only if employees lack social protection, through public programmes or benefits offered by the company: countries where unemployment starting while working for the company is not covered by the existing social protection (ESRS S1, §31(b)). Answer ‘None’ if all employees are covered. Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125(f) to §127(f)): may be omitted for financial years before 2027 (wave-one undertakings) or for the first year of reporting (other undertakings). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PROTECTION-ACCIDENT.name: Countries without social protection: employment injury and disability
SOC-PROTECTION-ACCIDENT.definition: Only if employees lack social protection, through public programmes or benefits offered by the company: countries where employment injury and acquired disability is not covered by the existing social protection (ESRS S1, §31(c)). Answer ‘None’ if all employees are covered. Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125(f) to §127(f)): may be omitted for financial years before 2027 (wave-one undertakings) or for the first year of reporting (other undertakings). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PROTECTION-MATERNITE.name: Countries without social protection: maternity leave
SOC-PROTECTION-MATERNITE.definition: Only if employees lack social protection, through public programmes or benefits offered by the company: countries where maternity leave is not covered by the existing social protection (ESRS S1, §31(d)). Answer ‘None’ if all employees are covered. Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125(f) to §127(f)): may be omitted for financial years before 2027 (wave-one undertakings) or for the first year of reporting (other undertakings). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-SAL-ENTRETIENS.name: Employees with a formal performance and career review
SOC-SAL-ENTRETIENS.definition: Employees who took part during the period in a formalised performance and career development review (at least once a year, on criteria known to the employee and the manager), each counted once (ESRS S1, §35(a), AR 22). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125(f) to §127(f)): may be omitted for financial years before 2027 (wave-one undertakings) or for the first year of reporting (other undertakings). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: HR information system, payroll.

SOC-PART-ENTRETIENS.name: Share of employees with a performance and career review
SOC-PART-ENTRETIENS.definition: Calculated by the tool: employees with a review divided by the total headcount of S1-5 (ESRS S1, §35(a), AR 22). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-SST-COUVERTS.name: Own workforce covered by the health and safety management system
SOC-SST-COUVERTS.definition: People in the own workforce (employees and non-employees) covered at the end of the period by the company's occupational health and safety management system, based on legal requirements or recognised standards or guidelines, as a headcount (ESRS S1, §37(a), AR 24). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accident register, accident reports, health and safety department.

SOC-PERSONNEL.name: Own workforce (employees and non-employees)
SOC-PERSONNEL.definition: Calculated by the tool: employee headcount plus non-employees in the own workforce, at period end; an N/A number of non-employees counts as 0 (ESRS S1, §7, §37(a)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-PART-SST.name: Share of the own workforce covered by the health and safety management system
SOC-PART-SST.definition: Calculated by the tool: people covered divided by the own workforce (employees and non-employees), as a headcount (ESRS S1, §37(a), AR 24). If the number of non-employees is N/A, the share covers employees. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-DECES-MALADIE.name: Fatalities from work-related ill health (employees)
SOC-DECES-MALADIE.definition: Employees who died during the period from recordable work-related ill health (illness caused or made worse by work), subject to legal restrictions (ESRS S1, §37(b)(ii)). They are part of the work-related fatalities of employees. Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accident register, accident reports, health and safety department.

SOC-DECES-NON-SAL.name: Fatalities from work-related accidents (non-employees)
SOC-DECES-NON-SAL.definition: Non-employees in the own workforce who died during the period as a result of a recordable work-related accident, subject to legal restrictions (ESRS S1, §37(b)(i)). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in for non-employees (ESRS 1 §125(f) to §127(f)): may be omitted for financial years before 2027 (wave-one undertakings) or for the first year of reporting (other undertakings). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accident register, accident reports, health and safety department.

SOC-DECES-SITE.name: Fatalities from work-related accidents (other workers on the sites)
SOC-DECES-SITE.definition: Workers who are not part of the own workforce (subcontractors, for example) but work on the company's sites, who died during the period as a result of a recordable work-related accident, subject to legal restrictions (ESRS S1, §37(b)(i)). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accident register, accident reports, health and safety department.

SOC-DECES-ACCIDENTS.name: Fatalities from work-related accidents (own workforce and workers on the sites)
SOC-DECES-ACCIDENTS.definition: Calculated by the tool: work-related fatalities of employees minus those from ill health, plus the accident fatalities of non-employees and of other workers on the sites (ESRS S1, §37(b)(i)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-DECES-TOUS.name: Work-related fatalities, all workers
SOC-DECES-TOUS.definition: Calculated by the tool: the sum the standard asks for, fatalities from work-related accidents (own workforce and other workers on the sites) and fatalities of employees from work-related ill health (ESRS S1, §37(b)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-ACCIDENTS-NON-SAL.name: Recordable work-related accidents (non-employees)
SOC-ACCIDENTS-NON-SAL.definition: Work-related accidents of non-employees in the own workforce during the period that resulted in death or more than three days of absence (ESRS S1, §37(c), AR 25, AR 26; glossary). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in for non-employees (ESRS 1 §125(f) to §127(f)): may be omitted for financial years before 2027 (wave-one undertakings) or for the first year of reporting (other undertakings). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accident register, accident reports, health and safety department.

SOC-ACCIDENTS-TOUS.name: Recordable work-related accidents (own workforce)
SOC-ACCIDENTS-TOUS.definition: Calculated by the tool: accidents of employees plus accidents of non-employees; fatal accidents are included (ESRS S1, §37(c), AR 26). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-HEURES-NON-SAL.name: Hours worked by non-employees
SOC-HEURES-NON-SAL.definition: Hours worked by non-employees in the own workforce during the period; if not known, estimated from normal working hours, paid leave deducted (ESRS S1, §37(c), AR 25). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in for non-employees (ESRS 1 §125(f) to §127(f)): may be omitted for financial years before 2027 (wave-one undertakings) or for the first year of reporting (other undertakings). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Contracts of self-employed people, statements and invoices of employment agencies.

SOC-HEURES-PERSONNEL.name: Hours worked by the own workforce (employees and non-employees)
SOC-HEURES-PERSONNEL.definition: Calculated by the tool: hours worked by employees plus those of non-employees; N/A hours of non-employees count as 0 (ESRS S1, §37(c), AR 25). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-TAUX-ACC-SALARIES.name: Rate of recordable work-related accidents of employees, per million hours worked
SOC-TAUX-ACC-SALARIES.definition: Calculated by the tool: recordable accidents of employees per million hours worked by employees (ESRS S1, §37(c), AR 25). Recalculated at each level from the totals. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-TAUX-ACC-NON-SAL.name: Rate of recordable work-related accidents of non-employees, per million hours worked
SOC-TAUX-ACC-NON-SAL.definition: Calculated by the tool: recordable accidents of non-employees per million hours worked by non-employees (ESRS S1, §37(c), AR 25). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-TAUX-ACCIDENTS.name: Rate of recordable work-related accidents of the own workforce, per million hours worked
SOC-TAUX-ACCIDENTS.definition: Calculated by the tool: recordable accidents of the own workforce (employees and non-employees) divided by the total hours worked by the own workforce, multiplied by 1,000,000: accidents per million hours, about 500 full-time people over one year (ESRS S1, §37(c), AR 25). Recalculated at each level from the totals. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-MALADIES-PRO.name: Cases of recordable work-related ill health (employees)
SOC-MALADIES-PRO.definition: Cases of work-related ill health of employees that resulted in death or absence, known during the period (reported by the person, a compensation agency or a healthcare professional, or found by medical surveillance); musculoskeletal disorders are included, subject to legal restrictions (ESRS S1, §37(d), AR 27). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125(f) to §127(f)): may be omitted for financial years before 2027 (wave-one undertakings) or for the first year of reporting (other undertakings). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accident register, accident reports, health and safety department.

SOC-JOURS-PERDUS-AT-MP.name: Days lost to work-related accidents and ill health (employees)
SOC-JOURS-PERDUS-AT-MP.definition: Days of absence of employees due to recordable work-related accidents and ill health, in calendar days, from the first full day to the last day of absence, weekends and public holidays included (ESRS S1, §37(e), AR 28). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125(f) to §127(f)): may be omitted for financial years before 2027 (wave-one undertakings) or for the first year of reporting (other undertakings). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accident register, accident reports, health and safety department.

SOC-SAL-CONGES-FAMILLE.name: Employees entitled to family-related leave
SOC-SAL-CONGES-FAMILLE.definition: Employees who are entitled, by law, a company policy, an agreement, their contract or a collective agreement, to family-related leave (maternity, paternity, parental, carers' leave), at the end of the period, as a headcount (ESRS S1, §39, AR 29, AR 30). The types of leave concerned are given in the methods text. Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in (ESRS 1 §125(f) to §127(f)): may be omitted for financial years before 2027 (wave-one undertakings) or for the first year of reporting (other undertakings). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: HR information system, payroll.

SOC-PART-CONGES-FAMILLE.name: Share of employees entitled to family-related leave
SOC-PART-CONGES-FAMILLE.definition: Calculated by the tool: employees entitled to family-related leave divided by the total headcount (ESRS S1, §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-S1-REMU-H-HOMMES.name: Average gross hourly pay level of all male employees
SOC-S1-REMU-H-HOMMES.definition: Average gross hourly pay level of all male employees of the company (ESRS S1, §41(a), AR 31): ordinary basic salary and any other remuneration made available to all employees, in cash or in kind, received directly or indirectly from the employer in respect of the employment (complementary or variable components) (AR 32). Method of ESRS S1, entered once for the whole company; say in the methods text how the average is calculated (AR 34). The Voluntary Standard VS and pay transparency have their own KPIs and their own calculation. Restricted data. Amount in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50): the unit follows the reference currency of the space (Frameworks › Units and formats), to set before you install the template; no value is converted. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Payroll.

SOC-S1-REMU-H-FEMMES.name: Average gross hourly pay level of all female employees
SOC-S1-REMU-H-FEMMES.definition: Average gross hourly pay level of all female employees of the company (ESRS S1, §41(a), AR 31): ordinary basic salary and any other remuneration made available to all employees, in cash or in kind, received directly or indirectly from the employer in respect of the employment (complementary or variable components) (AR 32). Method of ESRS S1, entered once for the whole company; say in the methods text how the average is calculated (AR 34). The Voluntary Standard VS and pay transparency have their own KPIs and their own calculation. Restricted data. Amount in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50): the unit follows the reference currency of the space (Frameworks › Units and formats), to set before you install the template; no value is converted. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Payroll.

SOC-ECART-REMU-H.name: Gender pay gap (hourly, all employees)
SOC-ECART-REMU-H.definition: Calculated by the tool, never entered: difference between the average gross hourly pay of men and that of women, as a share of men's, over all the company's employees; positive when women are paid less (ESRS S1, §41(a), AR 31 to AR 33). Unadjusted gap. The average hourly pay of men and of women is entered for the whole company: the gap is calculated at that level. Method of ESRS S1, on its own hourly pay figures: neither the gap of the Voluntary Standard VS (B10 §42(b), calculated in EFRAG's workbook) nor the per-employer gap of pay transparency. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-REMU-PLUS-HAUTE.name: Annual total remuneration of the highest-paid individual
SOC-REMU-PLUS-HAUTE.definition: Annual total remuneration of the company's highest-paid individual: base salary, cash benefits (bonuses, commissions, profit-sharing), benefits in kind (car, health insurance…) and fair value of the year's long-term incentives (stock options, performance shares…) (ESRS S1, §41(b), AR 35). Confidential data: it points to one person. Amount in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50): the unit follows the reference currency of the space (Frameworks › Units and formats), to set before you install the template; no value is converted. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Payroll.

SOC-REMU-MEDIANE.name: Median annual total remuneration of employees (excluding the highest-paid)
SOC-REMU-MEDIANE.definition: Median annual total remuneration of all employees, without the highest-paid individual, with the same pay components: half of the employees earn more, half earn less (ESRS S1, §41(b), AR 35). A median cannot be derived from those of the entities: entered for the whole company. Amount in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50): the unit follows the reference currency of the space (Frameworks › Units and formats), to set before you install the template; no value is converted. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Payroll.

SOC-RATIO-REMU.name: Annual total remuneration ratio
SOC-RATIO-REMU.definition: Calculated by the tool: annual total remuneration of the highest-paid individual divided by the median of the other employees; a number of times, without unit (ESRS S1, §41(b), AR 35). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

SOC-DISCRIMINATIONS.name: Substantiated incidents of discrimination
SOC-DISCRIMINATIONS.definition: Incidents of discrimination at work (gender, racial or ethnic origin, nationality, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation or other, harassment included) substantiated and identified during the period: judicial or non-judicial proceedings and other incidents, evidenced by verifiable facts and formally found by a court, the OECD or an administrative authority, subject to privacy rules (ESRS S1, §43(a), AR 37). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Legal department, human resources, grievance mechanism.

SOC-INCIDENTS-DH.name: Substantiated human rights incidents (own workforce, excluding discrimination)
SOC-INCIDENTS-DH.definition: Substantiated incidents of not respecting internationally recognised human rights connected to the own workforce, identified during the period, excluding discrimination (counted separately): judicial or non-judicial proceedings and other incidents, substantiated and found as for discrimination (ESRS S1, §43(b), AR 36). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Legal department, human resources, grievance mechanism.

SOC-AMENDES-DH.name: Fines, penalties and compensation for these incidents
SOC-AMENDES-DH.definition: Total fines, penalties and compensation for damages imposed through judicial or non-judicial proceedings for incidents of discrimination or other human rights incidents, recognised in the financial statements of the period (ESRS S1, §43(c), AR 41). Amount in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50): the unit follows the reference currency of the space (Frameworks › Units and formats), to set before you install the template; no value is converted. Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounting, legal department.

SOC-CHAINE-POLITIQUES.name: Policies adopted on workers in the value chain
SOC-CHAINE-POLITIQUES.definition: Has the company adopted policies to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on workers in the value chain? If not, answer No: the standard asks to say so (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-POLIT-CONTENU.name: Policies on workers in the value chain: contents and changes
SOC-CHAINE-POLIT-CONTENU.definition: For each policy: its key contents, its general objectives and the material impacts, risks or opportunities it addresses; describe the changes made during the period (ESRS 2 §42(a)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-POLIT-PERIMETRE.name: Policies on workers in the value chain: scope and exclusions
SOC-CHAINE-POLIT-PERIMETRE.definition: For each policy: its scope or exclusions (own operations, upstream and downstream value chain, geographies and, if defined, the affected stakeholder groups) (ESRS 2 §42(b)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-POLIT-REFERENCES.name: Policies on workers in the value chain: third-party standards or initiatives
SOC-CHAINE-POLIT-REFERENCES.definition: Third-party standards or initiatives that the company commits to respect through its policies (ESRS 2 §42(c)). Answer N/A if no policy refers to one. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-POLIT-PARTIES.name: Policies on workers in the value chain: interests of affected stakeholders
SOC-CHAINE-POLIT-PARTIES.definition: How the interests of affected stakeholders were considered in setting each policy, if they were (ESRS 2 §42(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-ACTIONS.name: Key actions on workers in the value chain
SOC-CHAINE-ACTIONS.definition: Has the company taken or planned key actions to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on workers in the value chain? If not, answer No (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-ACT-DESC.name: Key actions on workers in the value chain: description, scope and expected outcomes
SOC-CHAINE-ACT-DESC.definition: Key actions taken during the period and planned, with their timeframe, their scope (own operations, value chain, subsidiaries, geographies, stakeholders) and their expected outcomes, and how they serve the policy objectives (ESRS 2 §45). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-ACT-TAB.name: Key actions on workers in the value chain: timeframe and financial resources
SOC-CHAINE-ACT-TAB.unit: table: Key action, Status, Timeframe, Scope, Capital expenditure of the period, Operating expenditure of the period, Future resources, low estimate, Future resources, high estimate, Depends on preconditions
SOC-CHAINE-ACT-TAB.definition: One row per key action: status, timeframe, scope, capital and operating expenditure of the period, range of future resources, and whether the action depends on preconditions (ESRS 2 §45-46). Amounts only when significant resources are allocated. Amounts in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)). Source: Action plans, budget, accounting (capital and operating expenditure).

SOC-CHAINE-ACT-MOYENS.name: Key actions on workers in the value chain: type of resources, preconditions and line items
SOC-CHAINE-ACT-MOYENS.definition: When significant financial resources are allocated to the actions: their type (current and future), the preconditions the actions depend on (financial support, public policy, market) and the line items or notes of the financial statements that contain the amounts (ESRS 2 §46). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-CIBLES.name: Measurable targets on workers in the value chain
SOC-CHAINE-CIBLES.definition: Has the company set measurable, time-bound and outcome-oriented targets on workers in the value chain? If not, answer No and describe below how it tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-CIB-TAB.name: Targets on workers in the value chain: values, years and scope
SOC-CHAINE-CIB-TAB.unit: table: Target, Metric, Absolute or relative, Unit, Base year, Baseline value, Milestone year, Milestone value, Target year, Target value, Required by law, Based on conclusive scientific evidence, Scope
SOC-CHAINE-CIB-TAB.definition: One row per target: metric and unit, absolute or relative target, baseline value and year, milestone, target value and year, whether it is required by law, whether it is based on conclusive scientific evidence (environmental topics), scope (ESRS 2 §51). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)). Source: Company strategy, roadmaps and dashboards.

SOC-CHAINE-CIB-DESC.name: Targets on workers in the value chain: link to policies, milestones, methods and scenarios
