SOC-CHAINE-CIB-DESC.definition: For each target: its link to the policy objectives and actions, the milestones or interim targets, the methods and significant assumptions and, where applicable, the scenarios, the key data sources and the compatibility with national, EU or international policy goals (ESRS 2 §51(a), (e), (f), (h)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.name: Tracking of effectiveness without targets on workers in the value chain
SOC-CHAINE-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.definition: Only if no measurable target is set: whether and how the company still tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Answer N/A if targets are set. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-POLIT-COUVERTURE.name: Policies: all workers in the value chain or specific groups
SOC-CHAINE-POLIT-COUVERTURE.definition: For each policy: does it cover all workers in the value chain or only specific groups (for example an age group, or the workers of one factory or country)? Name the groups concerned (ESRS S2-1 §10). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-DIALOGUE.name: Engagement with workers in the value chain
SOC-CHAINE-DIALOGUE.definition: How the company engages directly with workers in the value chain, their legitimate representatives or credible proxies, and how their perspectives inform its decisions and activities to manage actual and potential impacts during the year (ESRS S2-2 §14). Engagement can take different forms, such as information sessions, consultation or participation (ESRS S2 AR 2). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-VULNERABLES.name: Perspectives of vulnerable workers in the value chain
SOC-CHAINE-VULNERABLES.definition: Only if the company takes action to understand the perspectives of workers in the value chain who may be particularly vulnerable or marginalised (for example women workers, migrant workers, workers with disabilities): how it gains insight into them (ESRS S2-2 §14(a)). Answer N/A if it takes no such action. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-CANAUX.name: Channels for workers in the value chain to raise concerns
SOC-CHAINE-CANAUX.definition: Channels available to workers in the value chain to bring their concerns or needs directly to the company and have them addressed, and how the company assesses their effectiveness (ESRS S2-2 §15). The effectiveness criteria for non-judicial grievance mechanisms of principle 31 of the UN Guiding Principles can be used (ESRS S2 AR 3). If the company protects the people who use these channels against retaliation and has disclosed it under business conduct (ESRS G1-1), it can refer to that disclosure. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-PLAINTES.name: Grievance mechanism for workers in the value chain
SOC-CHAINE-PLAINTES.definition: Has the company put in place a grievance mechanism that workers in the value chain can use? (ESRS S2-2 §15). Describe the channels in the text « Channels for workers in the value chain to raise concerns ». Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-REPARATION.name: Approach to remediation for workers in the value chain
SOC-CHAINE-REPARATION.definition: General approach and processes to provide or cooperate in remediation where the company has caused or contributed to a material negative impact on workers in the value chain (ESRS S2-2 §16). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-ACTIONS-IMPACTS.name: Actions on material negative impacts on workers in the value chain
SOC-CHAINE-ACTIONS-IMPACTS.definition: Key actions taken, planned or under way to prevent, mitigate, bring to an end, minimise and remediate material negative impacts on workers in the value chain, including the approach when these actions are in tension with other business pressures (for example in procurement or sales) (ESRS S2-3 §18(a)). Leverage and collective actions (multi-stakeholder or industry initiatives) are included (ESRS S2 AR 4). Present the measures against the effects of the transition to a low-carbon economy in a way that shows the link between topics (ESRS S2 AR 5). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-ACTIONS-SUIVI.name: Effectiveness tracking of actions on workers in the value chain
SOC-CHAINE-ACTIONS-SUIVI.definition: Only if actions on material negative impacts are reported: how the company tracks and assesses the effectiveness of these actions in delivering outcomes for the people concerned (ESRS S2-3 §18(b)). If it explains this in the targets (ESRS 2 GDR-T) or in an entity-specific metric (ESRS 2 GDR-M), a reference is enough. Answer N/A if no action on negative impacts is reported. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-INCIDENTS-DH.name: Human rights incidents connected to workers in the value chain
SOC-CHAINE-INCIDENTS-DH.definition: Human rights incidents connected to workers in the value chain identified during the period (ESRS S2-3 §19), subject to the relevant privacy rules. Report only substantiated and verified instances: backed by objective, factual information, and found by a court, the OECD or an administrative authority (ESRS S2 AR 6). This covers judicial and non-judicial proceedings and other incidents the company registered. You may group the cases by type of incident or by people concerned (ESRS S2 AR 8). Write that there were none, if that is the case. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-INDICATEURS.name: Entity-specific metrics on workers in the value chain
SOC-CHAINE-INDICATEURS.definition: Only if the company tracks this topic with its own metrics (the standard prescribes none): one row per metric, with its value, unit and scope (ESRS 2 §48, AR 42). Leave empty otherwise. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)). Source: Company strategy, roadmaps and dashboards.

SOC-CHAINE-METHODES.name: Metrics on workers in the value chain: methods, sources, value chain data and context
SOC-CHAINE-METHODES.definition: For each metric: unit, calculation method and sources, estimation method with its significant assumptions and limitations; for a value chain metric, reliance on indirect sources or proxies and the planned improvements; contextual information (ESRS 2 §49(a) to (c)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-EVOLUTION.name: Metrics on workers in the value chain: significant changes and progress
SOC-CHAINE-EVOLUTION.definition: Significant changes in performance compared with the previous periods, progress towards the targets and effect of major acquisitions or disposals (ESRS 2 §49(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-TRAITE.name: Value chain policies address trafficking in human beings
SOC-CHAINE-TRAITE.definition: Do the company's policies on workers in the value chain address trafficking in human beings? (ESRS S2-1 §11). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-TRAVAIL-FORCE.name: Value chain policies address forced or compulsory labour
SOC-CHAINE-TRAVAIL-FORCE.definition: Do the company's policies on workers in the value chain address forced or compulsory labour? (ESRS S2-1 §11). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-TRAVAIL-ENFANTS.name: Value chain policies address child labour
SOC-CHAINE-TRAVAIL-ENFANTS.definition: Do the company's policies on workers in the value chain address child labour? (ESRS S2-1 §11). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-CODE-FOURNIS.name: Supplier code of conduct
SOC-CHAINE-CODE-FOURNIS.definition: Does the company have a supplier code of conduct? (ESRS S2-1 §12). The information on supplier relationships (ESRS G1-2) can refer to it. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CHAINE-ACCORDS-CADRES.name: Global framework agreements on human rights of value chain workers
SOC-CHAINE-ACCORDS-CADRES.definition: Global framework agreements or other outcomes reached with representatives of workers in the value chain on respecting human rights (ESRS S2-2 §14(b)). Answer N/A if there are none. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-POLITIQUES.name: Policies adopted on affected communities
SOC-COMMU-POLITIQUES.definition: Has the company adopted policies to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on affected communities? If not, answer No: the standard asks to say so (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-POLIT-CONTENU.name: Policies on affected communities: contents and changes
SOC-COMMU-POLIT-CONTENU.definition: For each policy: its key contents, its general objectives and the material impacts, risks or opportunities it addresses; describe the changes made during the period (ESRS 2 §42(a)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-POLIT-PERIMETRE.name: Policies on affected communities: scope and exclusions
SOC-COMMU-POLIT-PERIMETRE.definition: For each policy: its scope or exclusions (own operations, upstream and downstream value chain, geographies and, if defined, the affected stakeholder groups) (ESRS 2 §42(b)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-POLIT-REFERENCES.name: Policies on affected communities: third-party standards or initiatives
SOC-COMMU-POLIT-REFERENCES.definition: Third-party standards or initiatives that the company commits to respect through its policies (ESRS 2 §42(c)). Answer N/A if no policy refers to one. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-POLIT-PARTIES.name: Policies on affected communities: interests of affected stakeholders
SOC-COMMU-POLIT-PARTIES.definition: How the interests of affected stakeholders were considered in setting each policy, if they were (ESRS 2 §42(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-ACTIONS.name: Key actions on affected communities
SOC-COMMU-ACTIONS.definition: Has the company taken or planned key actions to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on affected communities? If not, answer No (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-ACT-DESC.name: Key actions on affected communities: description, scope and expected outcomes
SOC-COMMU-ACT-DESC.definition: Key actions taken during the period and planned, with their timeframe, their scope (own operations, value chain, subsidiaries, geographies, stakeholders) and their expected outcomes, and how they serve the policy objectives (ESRS 2 §45). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-ACT-TAB.name: Key actions on affected communities: timeframe and financial resources
SOC-COMMU-ACT-TAB.unit: table: Key action, Status, Timeframe, Scope, Capital expenditure of the period, Operating expenditure of the period, Future resources, low estimate, Future resources, high estimate, Depends on preconditions
SOC-COMMU-ACT-TAB.definition: One row per key action: status, timeframe, scope, capital and operating expenditure of the period, range of future resources, and whether the action depends on preconditions (ESRS 2 §45-46). Amounts only when significant resources are allocated. Amounts in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)). Source: Action plans, budget, accounting (capital and operating expenditure).

SOC-COMMU-ACT-MOYENS.name: Key actions on affected communities: type of resources, preconditions and line items
SOC-COMMU-ACT-MOYENS.definition: When significant financial resources are allocated to the actions: their type (current and future), the preconditions the actions depend on (financial support, public policy, market) and the line items or notes of the financial statements that contain the amounts (ESRS 2 §46). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-CIBLES.name: Measurable targets on affected communities
SOC-COMMU-CIBLES.definition: Has the company set measurable, time-bound and outcome-oriented targets on affected communities? If not, answer No and describe below how it tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-CIB-TAB.name: Targets on affected communities: values, years and scope
SOC-COMMU-CIB-TAB.unit: table: Target, Metric, Absolute or relative, Unit, Base year, Baseline value, Milestone year, Milestone value, Target year, Target value, Required by law, Based on conclusive scientific evidence, Scope
SOC-COMMU-CIB-TAB.definition: One row per target: metric and unit, absolute or relative target, baseline value and year, milestone, target value and year, whether it is required by law, whether it is based on conclusive scientific evidence (environmental topics), scope (ESRS 2 §51). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)). Source: Company strategy, roadmaps and dashboards.

SOC-COMMU-CIB-DESC.name: Targets on affected communities: link to policies, milestones, methods and scenarios
SOC-COMMU-CIB-DESC.definition: For each target: its link to the policy objectives and actions, the milestones or interim targets, the methods and significant assumptions and, where applicable, the scenarios, the key data sources and the compatibility with national, EU or international policy goals (ESRS 2 §51(a), (e), (f), (h)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.name: Tracking of effectiveness without targets on affected communities
SOC-COMMU-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.definition: Only if no measurable target is set: whether and how the company still tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Answer N/A if targets are set. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-POLIT-COUVERTURE.name: Policies: all affected communities or specific communities
SOC-COMMU-POLIT-COUVERTURE.definition: For each policy: does it cover all affected communities or only specific communities (for example a community of indigenous peoples or a community living around a site)? Name the groups concerned (ESRS S3-1 §8). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-DIALOGUE.name: Engagement with affected communities
SOC-COMMU-DIALOGUE.definition: How the company engages directly with affected communities, their legitimate representatives or credible proxies, and how their perspectives inform its decisions and activities to manage actual and potential impacts during the year (ESRS S3-2 §11). Engagement can take different forms, such as information sessions, consultation or participation (ESRS S3 AR 2). Only if the company engages directly with them (see the previous yes / no item); answer N/A otherwise. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-VULNERABLES.name: Perspectives of vulnerable affected communities
SOC-COMMU-VULNERABLES.definition: Only if the company takes action to understand the perspectives of affected communities who may be particularly vulnerable or marginalised (for example women, girls, migrants, persons with disabilities): how it gains insight into them (ESRS S3-2 §11). Answer N/A if it takes no such action. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-CANAUX.name: Channels for affected communities to raise concerns
SOC-COMMU-CANAUX.definition: Channels available to affected communities to bring their concerns or needs directly to the company and have them addressed, and how the company assesses their effectiveness (ESRS S3-2 §13). The effectiveness criteria for non-judicial grievance mechanisms of principle 31 of the UN Guiding Principles can be used (ESRS S3 AR 4). If the company protects the people who use these channels against retaliation and has disclosed it under business conduct (ESRS G1-1), it can refer to that disclosure. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-PLAINTES.name: Grievance mechanism for affected communities
SOC-COMMU-PLAINTES.definition: Has the company put in place a grievance mechanism that affected communities can use? (ESRS S3-2 §13). Describe the channels in the text « Channels for affected communities to raise concerns ». Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-REPARATION.name: Approach to remediation for affected communities
SOC-COMMU-REPARATION.definition: General approach and processes to provide or cooperate in remediation where the company has caused or contributed to a material negative impact on affected communities (ESRS S3-2 §14). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-ACTIONS-IMPACTS.name: Actions on material negative impacts on affected communities
SOC-COMMU-ACTIONS-IMPACTS.definition: Key actions taken, planned or under way to prevent, mitigate, bring to an end, minimise and remediate material negative impacts on affected communities, including the approach when these actions are in tension with other business pressures (for example practices in planning and land acquisition, or in the exploitation and financing of raw materials) (ESRS S3-3 §16(a)). Leverage and collective actions (multi-stakeholder or industry initiatives) are included (ESRS S3 AR 5). Present the measures against the effects of the transition to a low-carbon economy in a way that shows the link between topics (ESRS S3 AR 6). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-ACTIONS-SUIVI.name: Effectiveness tracking of actions on affected communities
SOC-COMMU-ACTIONS-SUIVI.definition: Only if actions on material negative impacts are reported: how the company tracks and assesses the effectiveness of these actions in delivering outcomes for the people concerned (ESRS S3-3 §16(b)). If it explains this in the targets (ESRS 2 GDR-T) or in an entity-specific metric (ESRS 2 GDR-M), a reference is enough. Answer N/A if no action on negative impacts is reported. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-INCIDENTS-DH.name: Human rights incidents connected to affected communities
SOC-COMMU-INCIDENTS-DH.definition: Human rights incidents connected to affected communities identified during the period (ESRS S3-3 §17), subject to the relevant privacy rules. Report only substantiated and verified instances: backed by objective, factual information, and found by a court, the OECD or an administrative authority (ESRS S3 AR 7). This covers judicial and non-judicial proceedings and other incidents the company registered. You may group the cases by type of incident or by people concerned (ESRS S3 AR 10). Consider any legal disputes on land rights and on the free, prior and informed consent of indigenous peoples (S3 AR 8). Write that there were none, if that is the case. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-INDICATEURS.name: Entity-specific metrics on affected communities
SOC-COMMU-INDICATEURS.definition: Only if the company tracks this topic with its own metrics (the standard prescribes none): one row per metric, with its value, unit and scope (ESRS 2 §48, AR 42). Leave empty otherwise. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)). Source: Company strategy, roadmaps and dashboards.

SOC-COMMU-METHODES.name: Metrics on affected communities: methods, sources, value chain data and context
SOC-COMMU-METHODES.definition: For each metric: unit, calculation method and sources, estimation method with its significant assumptions and limitations; for a value chain metric, reliance on indirect sources or proxies and the planned improvements; contextual information (ESRS 2 §49(a) to (c)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-EVOLUTION.name: Metrics on affected communities: significant changes and progress
SOC-COMMU-EVOLUTION.definition: Significant changes in performance compared with the previous periods, progress towards the targets and effect of major acquisitions or disposals (ESRS 2 §49(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-DIALOGUE-DIRECT.name: Direct engagement with affected communities
SOC-COMMU-DIALOGUE-DIRECT.definition: Does the company engage directly with affected communities, their legitimate representatives or credible proxies? If yes, explain how in the text « Engagement with affected communities » (ESRS S3-2 §11). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-POLIT-AUTOCHTONES.name: Policies on impacts on indigenous peoples
SOC-COMMU-POLIT-AUTOCHTONES.definition: Particular policy provisions for preventing and addressing impacts on indigenous peoples (ESRS S3-1 §9). Write that there are none, if that is the case. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-AUTOCHTONES-CLPE.name: Rights of indigenous peoples, including free, prior and informed consent
SOC-COMMU-AUTOCHTONES-CLPE.definition: Only if affected communities are indigenous peoples: how the company takes into account and ensures respect of their particular rights in its engagement, including the right to free, prior and informed consent for their cultural, intellectual, religious and spiritual property, for activities affecting their lands and territories, and for legislative or administrative measures that affect them (ESRS S3-2 §12). For example: the process to obtain their consent and to ensure good-faith negotiations when relocation or occupation occurs (S3 AR 3). Answer N/A if no affected community is an indigenous people. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-AUTOCHTONES-CONS.name: Indigenous peoples consulted on the engagement
SOC-COMMU-AUTOCHTONES-CONS.definition: Only if the company engages with indigenous peoples: have they been consulted on the mode and parameters of the engagement (for example the agenda, nature and timing)? (ESRS S3-2 §12). Answer N/A if there is no engagement with indigenous peoples. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-COMMU-AUTOCHT-CONS-DESC.name: How indigenous peoples were consulted on the engagement
SOC-COMMU-AUTOCHT-CONS-DESC.definition: Only if the company engages with indigenous peoples: how they have been consulted on the mode and parameters of the engagement (ESRS S3-2 §12). Answer N/A if there is no engagement with indigenous peoples. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-POLITIQUES.name: Policies adopted on consumers and end-users
SOC-CONSO-POLITIQUES.definition: Has the company adopted policies to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on consumers and end-users? If not, answer No: the standard asks to say so (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-POLIT-CONTENU.name: Policies on consumers and end-users: contents and changes
SOC-CONSO-POLIT-CONTENU.definition: For each policy: its key contents, its general objectives and the material impacts, risks or opportunities it addresses; describe the changes made during the period (ESRS 2 §42(a)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-POLIT-PERIMETRE.name: Policies on consumers and end-users: scope and exclusions
SOC-CONSO-POLIT-PERIMETRE.definition: For each policy: its scope or exclusions (own operations, upstream and downstream value chain, geographies and, if defined, the affected stakeholder groups) (ESRS 2 §42(b)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-POLIT-REFERENCES.name: Policies on consumers and end-users: third-party standards or initiatives
SOC-CONSO-POLIT-REFERENCES.definition: Third-party standards or initiatives that the company commits to respect through its policies (ESRS 2 §42(c)). Answer N/A if no policy refers to one. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-POLIT-PARTIES.name: Policies on consumers and end-users: interests of affected stakeholders
SOC-CONSO-POLIT-PARTIES.definition: How the interests of affected stakeholders were considered in setting each policy, if they were (ESRS 2 §42(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-ACTIONS.name: Key actions on consumers and end-users
SOC-CONSO-ACTIONS.definition: Has the company taken or planned key actions to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on consumers and end-users? If not, answer No (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-ACT-DESC.name: Key actions on consumers and end-users: description, scope and expected outcomes
SOC-CONSO-ACT-DESC.definition: Key actions taken during the period and planned, with their timeframe, their scope (own operations, value chain, subsidiaries, geographies, stakeholders) and their expected outcomes, and how they serve the policy objectives (ESRS 2 §45). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-ACT-TAB.name: Key actions on consumers and end-users: timeframe and financial resources
SOC-CONSO-ACT-TAB.unit: table: Key action, Status, Timeframe, Scope, Capital expenditure of the period, Operating expenditure of the period, Future resources, low estimate, Future resources, high estimate, Depends on preconditions
SOC-CONSO-ACT-TAB.definition: One row per key action: status, timeframe, scope, capital and operating expenditure of the period, range of future resources, and whether the action depends on preconditions (ESRS 2 §45-46). Amounts only when significant resources are allocated. Amounts in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)). Source: Action plans, budget, accounting (capital and operating expenditure).

SOC-CONSO-ACT-MOYENS.name: Key actions on consumers and end-users: type of resources, preconditions and line items
SOC-CONSO-ACT-MOYENS.definition: When significant financial resources are allocated to the actions: their type (current and future), the preconditions the actions depend on (financial support, public policy, market) and the line items or notes of the financial statements that contain the amounts (ESRS 2 §46). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-CIBLES.name: Measurable targets on consumers and end-users
SOC-CONSO-CIBLES.definition: Has the company set measurable, time-bound and outcome-oriented targets on consumers and end-users? If not, answer No and describe below how it tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-CIB-TAB.name: Targets on consumers and end-users: values, years and scope
SOC-CONSO-CIB-TAB.unit: table: Target, Metric, Absolute or relative, Unit, Base year, Baseline value, Milestone year, Milestone value, Target year, Target value, Required by law, Based on conclusive scientific evidence, Scope
SOC-CONSO-CIB-TAB.definition: One row per target: metric and unit, absolute or relative target, baseline value and year, milestone, target value and year, whether it is required by law, whether it is based on conclusive scientific evidence (environmental topics), scope (ESRS 2 §51). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)). Source: Company strategy, roadmaps and dashboards.

SOC-CONSO-CIB-DESC.name: Targets on consumers and end-users: link to policies, milestones, methods and scenarios
SOC-CONSO-CIB-DESC.definition: For each target: its link to the policy objectives and actions, the milestones or interim targets, the methods and significant assumptions and, where applicable, the scenarios, the key data sources and the compatibility with national, EU or international policy goals (ESRS 2 §51(a), (e), (f), (h)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.name: Tracking of effectiveness without targets on consumers and end-users
SOC-CONSO-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.definition: Only if no measurable target is set: whether and how the company still tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Answer N/A if targets are set. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-POLIT-COUVERTURE.name: Policies: all consumers and end-users or specific groups
SOC-CONSO-POLIT-COUVERTURE.definition: For each policy: does it cover all consumers and end-users or only specific groups (for example an age group)? Name the groups concerned (ESRS S4-1 §9). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-DIALOGUE.name: Engagement with consumers and end-users
SOC-CONSO-DIALOGUE.definition: How the company engages directly with consumers and end-users, their legitimate representatives or credible proxies, and how their perspectives inform its decisions and activities to manage actual and potential impacts during the year (ESRS S4-2 §11). Engagement can take different forms, such as information sessions, consultation or participation (ESRS S4 AR 2). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-VULNERABLES.name: Perspectives of vulnerable consumers and end-users
SOC-CONSO-VULNERABLES.definition: Only if the company takes action to understand the perspectives of consumers and end-users who may be particularly vulnerable or marginalised (for example persons with disabilities, children): how it gains insight into them (ESRS S4-2 §11). Answer N/A if it takes no such action. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-CANAUX.name: Channels for consumers and end-users to raise concerns
SOC-CONSO-CANAUX.definition: Channels available to consumers and end-users to bring their concerns or needs directly to the company and have them addressed, and how the company assesses their effectiveness (ESRS S4-2 §12). The effectiveness criteria for non-judicial grievance mechanisms of principle 31 of the UN Guiding Principles can be used (ESRS S4 AR 3). If the company protects the people who use these channels against retaliation and has disclosed it under business conduct (ESRS G1-1), it can refer to that disclosure. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-PLAINTES.name: Grievance mechanism for consumers and end-users
SOC-CONSO-PLAINTES.definition: Has the company put in place a grievance mechanism that consumers and end-users can use? (ESRS S4-2 §12). Describe the channels in the text « Channels for consumers and end-users to raise concerns ». Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-REPARATION.name: Approach to remediation for consumers and end-users
SOC-CONSO-REPARATION.definition: General approach and processes to provide or cooperate in remediation where the company has caused or contributed to a material negative impact on consumers and end-users (ESRS S4-2 §13). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-ACTIONS-IMPACTS.name: Actions on material negative impacts on consumers and end-users
SOC-CONSO-ACTIONS-IMPACTS.definition: Key actions taken, planned or under way to prevent, mitigate, bring to an end, minimise and remediate material negative impacts on consumers and end-users, including the approach when these actions are in tension with other business pressures (for example practices related to marketing, sales and data use) (ESRS S4-3 §15(a)). Leverage and collective actions (multi-stakeholder or industry initiatives) are included (ESRS S4 AR 4). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-ACTIONS-SUIVI.name: Effectiveness tracking of actions on consumers and end-users
SOC-CONSO-ACTIONS-SUIVI.definition: Only if actions on material negative impacts are reported: how the company tracks and assesses the effectiveness of these actions in delivering outcomes for the people concerned (ESRS S4-3 §15(b)). If it explains this in the targets (ESRS 2 GDR-T) or in an entity-specific metric (ESRS 2 GDR-M), a reference is enough. Answer N/A if no action on negative impacts is reported. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-INCIDENTS-DH.name: Human rights incidents connected to consumers and end-users
SOC-CONSO-INCIDENTS-DH.definition: Human rights incidents connected to consumers and end-users identified during the period (ESRS S4-3 §16), subject to the relevant privacy rules. Report only substantiated and verified instances: backed by objective, factual information, and found by a court, the OECD or an administrative authority (ESRS S4 AR 5). This covers judicial and non-judicial proceedings and other incidents the company registered. You may group the cases by type of incident or by people concerned (ESRS S4 AR 7). Write that there were none, if that is the case. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-INDICATEURS.name: Entity-specific metrics on consumers and end-users
SOC-CONSO-INDICATEURS.definition: Only if the company tracks this topic with its own metrics (the standard prescribes none): one row per metric, with its value, unit and scope (ESRS 2 §48, AR 42). Leave empty otherwise. Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)). Source: Company strategy, roadmaps and dashboards.

SOC-CONSO-METHODES.name: Metrics on consumers and end-users: methods, sources, value chain data and context
SOC-CONSO-METHODES.definition: For each metric: unit, calculation method and sources, estimation method with its significant assumptions and limitations; for a value chain metric, reliance on indirect sources or proxies and the planned improvements; contextual information (ESRS 2 §49(a) to (c)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

SOC-CONSO-EVOLUTION.name: Metrics on consumers and end-users: significant changes and progress
SOC-CONSO-EVOLUTION.definition: Significant changes in performance compared with the previous periods, progress towards the targets and effect of major acquisitions or disposals (ESRS 2 §49(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2), other companies for their first two financial years of reporting (ESRS 1 §125(a), §126(a) and §127(a)).

GOV-CONDUITE-POLITIQUES.name: Policies adopted on business conduct
GOV-CONDUITE-POLITIQUES.definition: Has the company adopted policies to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on business conduct? If not, answer No: the standard asks to say so (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-CONDUITE-POLIT-CONTENU.name: Policies on business conduct: contents and changes
GOV-CONDUITE-POLIT-CONTENU.definition: For each policy: its key contents, its general objectives and the material impacts, risks or opportunities it addresses; describe the changes made during the period (ESRS 2 §42(a)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-CONDUITE-POLIT-PERIMETRE.name: Policies on business conduct: scope and exclusions
GOV-CONDUITE-POLIT-PERIMETRE.definition: For each policy: its scope or exclusions (own operations, upstream and downstream value chain, geographies and, if defined, the affected stakeholder groups) (ESRS 2 §42(b)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-CONDUITE-POLIT-REFERENCES.name: Policies on business conduct: third-party standards or initiatives
GOV-CONDUITE-POLIT-REFERENCES.definition: Third-party standards or initiatives that the company commits to respect through its policies (ESRS 2 §42(c)). Answer N/A if no policy refers to one. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-CONDUITE-ACTIONS.name: Key actions on business conduct
GOV-CONDUITE-ACTIONS.definition: Has the company taken or planned key actions to manage its material impacts, risks and opportunities on business conduct? If not, answer No (ESRS 2 §39). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-CONDUITE-ACT-DESC.name: Key actions on business conduct: description, scope and expected outcomes
GOV-CONDUITE-ACT-DESC.definition: Key actions taken during the period and planned, with their timeframe, their scope (own operations, value chain, subsidiaries, geographies, stakeholders) and their expected outcomes, and how they serve the policy objectives (ESRS 2 §45). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-CONDUITE-ACT-TAB.name: Key actions on business conduct: timeframe and financial resources
GOV-CONDUITE-ACT-TAB.unit: table: Key action, Status, Timeframe, Scope, Capital expenditure of the period, Operating expenditure of the period, Future resources, low estimate, Future resources, high estimate, Depends on preconditions
GOV-CONDUITE-ACT-TAB.definition: One row per key action: status, timeframe, scope, capital and operating expenditure of the period, range of future resources, and whether the action depends on preconditions (ESRS 2 §45-46). Amounts only when significant resources are allocated. Amounts in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Action plans, budget, accounting (capital and operating expenditure).

GOV-CONDUITE-ACT-MOYENS.name: Key actions on business conduct: type of resources, preconditions and line items
GOV-CONDUITE-ACT-MOYENS.definition: When significant financial resources are allocated to the actions: their type (current and future), the preconditions the actions depend on (financial support, public policy, market) and the line items or notes of the financial statements that contain the amounts (ESRS 2 §46). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-CONDUITE-CIBLES.name: Measurable targets on business conduct
GOV-CONDUITE-CIBLES.definition: Has the company set measurable, time-bound and outcome-oriented targets on business conduct? If not, answer No and describe below how it tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-CONDUITE-CIB-TAB.name: Targets on business conduct: values, years and scope
GOV-CONDUITE-CIB-TAB.unit: table: Target, Metric, Absolute or relative, Unit, Base year, Baseline value, Milestone year, Milestone value, Target year, Target value, Required by law, Based on conclusive scientific evidence, Scope
GOV-CONDUITE-CIB-TAB.definition: One row per target: metric and unit, absolute or relative target, baseline value and year, milestone, target value and year, whether it is required by law, whether it is based on conclusive scientific evidence (environmental topics), scope (ESRS 2 §51). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Company strategy, roadmaps and dashboards.

GOV-CONDUITE-CIB-DESC.name: Targets on business conduct: link to policies, milestones, methods and scenarios
GOV-CONDUITE-CIB-DESC.definition: For each target: its link to the policy objectives and actions, the milestones or interim targets, the methods and significant assumptions and, where applicable, the scenarios, the key data sources and the compatibility with national, EU or international policy goals (ESRS 2 §51(a), (e), (f), (h)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-CONDUITE-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.name: Tracking of effectiveness without targets on business conduct
GOV-CONDUITE-SUIVI-SS-CIBLE.definition: Only if no measurable target is set: whether and how the company still tracks the effectiveness of its policies and actions (ESRS 2 §52). Answer N/A if targets are set. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-CONDUITE-METHODES.name: Metrics on business conduct: methods, sources, value chain data and context
GOV-CONDUITE-METHODES.definition: For each metric: unit, calculation method and sources, estimation method with its significant assumptions and limitations; for a value chain metric, reliance on indirect sources or proxies and the planned improvements; contextual information (ESRS 2 §49(a) to (c)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-CONDUITE-EVOLUTION.name: Metrics on business conduct: significant changes and progress
GOV-CONDUITE-EVOLUTION.definition: Significant changes in performance compared with the previous periods, progress towards the targets and effect of major acquisitions or disposals (ESRS 2 §49(d)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-POLIT-ANTICORRUPTION.name: Anti-corruption and anti-bribery policies consistent with the UN Convention
GOV-POLIT-ANTICORRUPTION.definition: Does the company have anti-corruption and anti-bribery policies consistent with the United Nations Convention against Corruption? (ESRS G1-1 §7(a)). Corruption and bribery: the generic definition of the ESRS glossary applies, not the one of a local law (G1 AR 1). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-POLIT-LANCEURS.name: Whistle-blower protection policies
GOV-POLIT-LANCEURS.definition: Does the company have policies on the protection of whistle-blowers? (ESRS G1-1 §7(b)). A company subject to the national law transposing Directive (EU) 2019/1937, or to an equivalent requirement, can answer Yes by stating that it is subject to it (G1 AR 2). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-FONCTIONS-RISQUE.name: Functions most at risk of corruption or bribery
GOV-FONCTIONS-RISQUE.definition: Functions or roles within the company that are most at risk of corruption or bribery because of their tasks and responsibilities: for example those operating in high-risk countries or interacting with public authorities and governments (ESRS G1-1 §7(c), G1 AR 3). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-FOURNIS-RELATIONS.name: Management of relationships with suppliers
GOV-FOURNIS-RELATIONS.definition: How the company manages its relationships with suppliers (ESRS G1-2 §9(a)). The three points below each have their own item: sustainability in supplier selection, training of the procurement team, engagement with suppliers. A reference to the supplier code of conduct (ESRS S2-1 §12) is possible (G1 AR 4). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-FOURNIS-SELECTION.name: Sustainability in the selection of suppliers
GOV-FOURNIS-SELECTION.definition: Only if the company takes sustainability performance into account in selecting its suppliers: how it does so (ESRS G1-2 §9(a)(i)). Answer N/A if it does not. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-ACHATS-FORMATION.name: Sustainability training of the procurement team
GOV-ACHATS-FORMATION.definition: Does the procurement team receive training on sustainability? (ESRS G1-2 §9(a)(ii)). Answer No if there is none. Give the details in the text « Management of relationships with suppliers ». Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-FOURNIS-ENGAGEMENT.name: Engagement with suppliers on their sustainability performance
GOV-FOURNIS-ENGAGEMENT.definition: How the company engages with suppliers to improve their sustainability performance (ESRS G1-2 §9(a)(iii)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-CORRUPTION-PROCEDURES.name: Procedures against corruption and bribery
GOV-CORRUPTION-PROCEDURES.definition: The company's procedures to prevent, detect, investigate and respond to allegations or incidents related to corruption or bribery (ESRS G1-2 §9(b)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-CORRUPTION-FORMATION.name: Anti-corruption training of functions at risk
GOV-CORRUPTION-FORMATION.definition: Anti-corruption and anti-bribery training given to the functions or roles most at risk, including the members of the administrative, management and supervisory bodies (ESRS G1-2 §9(b)(i)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-CORRUPTION-MANQUEMENTS.name: Actions taken on breaches of anti-corruption procedures
GOV-CORRUPTION-MANQUEMENTS.definition: Any actions taken to address breaches in procedures and standards of anti-corruption and anti-bribery (ESRS G1-2 §9(b)(ii)). Write that there was no breach, if that is the case. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-SANCTIONS-CORRUP.name: Administrative sanctions for corruption or bribery
GOV-SANCTIONS-CORRUP.definition: Number of final decisions issued during the period by administrative or regulatory authorities against the company or an individual in respect of corruption or bribery (ESRS G1-4 §12, G1 AR 5). Convictions of criminal courts are counted in « Convictions for corruption or bribery ». Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Legal department, compliance, register of court decisions.

GOV-CONDAMN-SANCTIONS.name: Convictions and sanctions for corruption or bribery
GOV-CONDAMN-SANCTIONS.definition: Calculated by the tool: final criminal convictions plus final administrative sanctions for corruption or bribery during the period (ESRS G1-4 §12, G1 AR 5). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-CONTRIBUTIONS-POLIT.name: Financial and in-kind political contributions
GOV-CONTRIBUTIONS-POLIT.definition: Total monetary value of financial and in-kind political contributions made during the period, directly and indirectly (ESRS G1-5 §14). Political contribution: financial or in-kind support given directly to political parties, their elected representatives or persons seeking political office (donations, loans, sponsorships, advance payments, tickets to fundraising events; advertising, use of facilities, printing, equipment, board membership or employment) (G1 AR 7). Indirect: made through an intermediary (lobbyist, charity) or support to a think tank or trade association linked to a party or cause (G1 AR 8). Value in-kind contributions at their monetary value. The breakdown by country comes from the organisation tree. Amount in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50): the unit follows the reference currency of the space (Frameworks › Units and formats), to set before you install the template; no value is converted. Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounting, legal department.

GOV-CONTRIBUTIONS-DETAIL.name: Political contributions by type of recipient
GOV-CONTRIBUTIONS-DETAIL.definition: Breakdown of the political contributions by type of recipient or beneficiary (party, elected representative, candidate; for indirect contributions, intermediary, think tank, trade association) (ESRS G1-5 §14, G1 AR 7 and 8). Write the amounts. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-LOBBYING.name: Main topics and positions of lobbying activities
GOV-LOBBYING.definition: Main issues covered by the company's lobbying activities and main positions taken, with an explanation of how these activities interact with its material impacts, risks and opportunities (ESRS G1-5 §15). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-NOMINATIONS-PUBLIC.name: Members of the bodies appointed from public administration
GOV-NOMINATIONS-PUBLIC.definition: Appointments during the period of members of the administrative, management and supervisory bodies who held a comparable position in public administration (regulators included) in the two preceding years. To judge whether a position is comparable, consider the level of responsibility and the scope of the activities (ESRS G1-5 §16, G1 AR 9). Write that there were none, if that is the case. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-PAIEMENT-CONDITIONS.name: Standard payment terms by main category of suppliers
GOV-PAIEMENT-CONDITIONS.definition: Description of the company's standard payment terms, in number of days, by main category of suppliers; specify those that apply to small and medium-sized undertakings (SMEs) if they differ (ESRS G1-6 §18(a)). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-PAIEMENT-JOURS.name: Standard payment terms, in days
GOV-PAIEMENT-JOURS.definition: Number of days of the standard payment terms applied to suppliers (ESRS G1-6 §18(a)). If the terms differ by category, enter those of the main category and describe the others in the text « Standard payment terms by main category of suppliers ». It is not the actual average payment time. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: General terms of purchase, payment policy, accounts payable.

GOV-PAIEMENT-JOURS-PME.name: Standard payment terms for SME suppliers, in days
GOV-PAIEMENT-JOURS-PME.definition: Only if the standard payment terms of SME suppliers differ from those of other suppliers: number of days (ESRS G1-6 §18(a)). Answer N/A if they are the same. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: General terms of purchase, payment policy, accounts payable.

GOV-FACTURES.name: Supplier invoices paid
GOV-FACTURES.definition: Number of supplier invoices paid during the period. Together with « Invoices paid within the standard terms », it gives the tool the share of payments aligned with the standard terms (ESRS G1-6 §18(b)). The standard does not say whether the share is based on the number or on the value of the payments; the tool gives both: by number of invoices here, by value with the amounts paid. Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounts payable: list of the invoices paid in the period.

GOV-FACTURES-A-TEMPS.name: Invoices paid within the standard terms
GOV-FACTURES-A-TEMPS.definition: Among the invoices paid during the period, the number paid within the company's standard payment terms (ESRS G1-6 §18(b)). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounts payable: due date and payment date of each invoice.

GOV-PAIEMENT-PART-CONFORME.name: Share of payments aligned with the standard terms, by number of invoices
GOV-PAIEMENT-PART-CONFORME.definition: Calculated by the tool: invoices paid within the standard terms divided by invoices paid (ESRS G1-6 §18(b), G1 AR 10). If late payment to SMEs is a material topic for the company, add an entity-specific metric (ESRS 1 §11). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-FACTURES-MONTANT.name: Amount of supplier invoices paid
GOV-FACTURES-MONTANT.definition: Total amount of the supplier invoices paid during the period. Together with « Amount of invoices paid within the standard terms », it gives the tool the share of payments aligned with the standard terms by value (ESRS G1-6 §18(b)). Amount in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50): the unit follows the reference currency of the space (Frameworks › Units and formats), to set before you install the template; no value is converted. Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounts payable: amounts of the invoices paid in the period.

GOV-FACTURES-MONTANT-A-TEMPS.name: Amount of invoices paid within the standard terms
GOV-FACTURES-MONTANT-A-TEMPS.definition: Among the invoices paid during the period, the amount of those paid within the company's standard payment terms (ESRS G1-6 §18(b)). Amount in the currency of the financial statements (ESRS 1 AR 50): the unit follows the reference currency of the space (Frameworks › Units and formats), to set before you install the template; no value is converted. Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Accounts payable: due date, payment date and amount of each payment.

GOV-PAIEMENT-PART-CONFORME-VAL.name: Share of payments aligned with the standard terms, by value
GOV-PAIEMENT-PART-CONFORME-VAL.definition: Calculated by the tool: amount of the invoices paid within the standard terms divided by the amount of the invoices paid (ESRS G1-6 §18(b)). The standard does not say whether the share is measured by number or by value: the tool gives both, the company says in its methods which one it discloses, or discloses both. Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)).

GOV-PAIEMENT-CONTENTIEUX.name: Outstanding legal proceedings for late payment
GOV-PAIEMENT-CONTENTIEUX.definition: Number of legal proceedings outstanding at the end of the period for late payments (ESRS G1-6 §18(c)). Enter 0 if there is none (N/A would make the total not applicable). Phase-in: wave-one companies that, at the balance sheet date, do not exceed a net turnover of EUR 450 million or an average of 1,000 employees during the financial year may omit it for financial years before 2027, subject to the disclosures of ESRS 2 §7 to 10 (BP-2) (ESRS 1 §126(a)). Source: Legal department, compliance, register of court decisions.
